jd_text:
Join Accenture's Industry & Enterprise Insurance team and help leading insurers across Belgium and Europe transform their business to meet the challenges of tomorrow.
As an Insurance Management Consultant, you will work with leading insurance clients on strategic, operational, and technology-driven transformation programs. You will support organizations in improving performance, enhancing customer and broker experiences, modernizing operations, and unlocking the value of digital technologies and data.
A particular focus of this role is Employee Benefits (Group Insurance). We are looking for professionals who have gained experience and/or developed expertise within the Employee Benefits ecosystem, including areas such as pensions, group life insurance, disability coverage, and Employee Benefits operations.
You will be part of a dynamic consulting team delivering impactful projects from strategy through execution. Besides contributing to client engagements, you will play an active role in business development, internal capability building, and coaching more junior colleagues.
Key Responsibilities
· Lead and support strategic and operational transformation projects for insurance clients
· Analyze business processes, operating models, customer journeys, and technology landscapes to identify improvement opportunities
· Design and implement transformation initiatives focused on operational excellence, digital transformation, customer experience, and innovation
· Contribute expertise in Employee Benefits and Group Insurance topics across client engagements
· Facilitate client workshops, stakeholder interviews, and working sessions with business and technology teams
· Develop executive-level presentations, business cases, and recommendations for senior client stakeholders
· Support proposal development, RFP responses, and business development activities
· Coach and mentor analysts and junior consultants within the team
· Stay up to date on insurance market trends, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies
· Contribute to thought leadership and capability development within Accenture's Insurance practice
Your Background
We're looking for ambitious professionals who are passionate about insurance and transformation and who are ready to take the next step in their consulting career.
Qualifications
· Master's degree in Business Engineering, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Sciences, Engineering, or a related field
· 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in consulting, insurance, project management, business transformation, process improvement, digital transformation, or a related field
· Experience and/or strong knowledge of Employee Benefits (Group Insurance) products, processes, and market dynamics
· Understanding of insurance operating models, distribution channels, and core business processes
· Experience working with multiple stakeholders in complex transformation environments
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking skills
· Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation abilities
· Strong client-facing mindset and ability to build trusted relationships
· Fluent in English and either Dutch or French
· A proactive, entrepreneurial, and team-oriented attitude
What We Offer
At Accenture, you'll help shape the future of the insurance industry while accelerating your own career.
· A permanent contract with competitive compensation and benefits
· The opportunity to work with leading insurers on high-impact transformation programs
· Continuous learning and access to Accenture's global expertise, methodologies, and training ecosystem
· A clear and transparent career development path
· Exposure to senior client stakeholders and international teams
· Opportunities to contribute to business development and thought leadership
· A collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work environment
· Hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements

jd_text:
Are you ready to take on a new challenge & join our Service Team as a Customer Advisory Consultant ?
We are currently looking for talented and motivated people who will:
· Support in shaping the agenda of multiple C-level positions on the customer agenda
· Operate with a client-first mindset and shape the path to deliver successful outcomes by communicating in a concise way with all clients
· Design customer experience to unlock growth and trapped value
· Conduct assessments to help to identify vulnerabilities, challenges, and opportunities in the current state of our clients
· Help our clients to gain deeper insights in the customer and their needs, behaviors, and frustrations, in order to define a customer strategy and differentiated value propositions.
· Demonstrate strong analytical skills by developing financial models and business cases, measuring the value generated from improved customer experience and/or reduced cost-to-serve.
· Quickly absorb information and are able to understand and structure complex problems.
Keep on reading to learn more about the job , your future colleagues & all that Accenture has to offer!
Your job
You will be involved in driving business development opportunities and will focus on delivering innovative and action-oriented business solutions and strategies for our leading clients. Within a broader project team, you will develop data-driven insights and formulate recommendations to solve complex challenges on the customer agenda. You will lead and deliver workstreams to drive the ambitioned outcomes, in continuous collaboration with the client. With a people-first mindset, you coach and mentor analysts and junior consultants to support them in further developing their strengths. Much of the work we do is at the cutting edge of innovation and thinking. We involve our people in the latest and newest innovative trends and they largely contribute in publishing and sharing this knowledge as thought leadership to benefit clients, industry, and fellow colleagues.
Your team
Accenture Song is an incredible place to work where you can keep learning. By joining us, you’ll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we’re proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. We want to get to know the real you and help you explore and grow - whatever it is you're great at. So you will always have lots of learning opportunities (formal and informal) to improve your role-specific skills and expertise.
Your background
· 3-5 years of experience
· Demonstrate prior consulting experience or have a relevant project management background.
· Master’s degree in Applied Economics, Commercial Engineering or equivalent
· Former business school students or MBA students
· Functional experience with growth, go-to-market, commercial, customer & distribution strategies
· Experience in digital/Strategic transformation programs & value realization, operating model redesigns or service designs
· Experience in Business analysis, process design, customer journey and maturity assessment
· High competence in preparing materials and performing presentations required (MS Office PowerPoint, Excel, Word))
· Proven presentation and storytelling skills, personal impact and confidence to lead meetings, presentations and workshops
· Ability to effectively lead a workstream within a broader project scope
· First class written and verbal communication skills; the ability to articulate complex problems and solutions in a simple, logical and impactful manner
· Technology knowledge of CRM platforms, Marketplaces, eCommerce, customer analytics solutions, Engagement centers, conversational AI & chat, customer portals etc.
· Entrepreneurial spirit
· Effective communication in Dutch or French, and English
Our offer
At Accenture, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace that values diversity and promotes growth for all. As you join our global company with a world-class brand and reputation, we want to assure you that you will be part of a vibrant, diverse workplace culture. We firmly believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, and we celebrate the unique contributions of every individual. We are dedicated to getting to know the real you and supporting your personal and professional growth, so you can excel in whatever you're great at. At Accenture, learning is a continuous journey, and we provide numerous learning opportunities, both formal and informal, to enhance your role-specific skills and expertise.
Beyond the impactful work we do for our clients and the nurturing work environment we provide, we offer a range of excellent employee benefits designed to cater to your diverse needs and well-being. These benefits include:
· 13th month + holiday allowance : Ensuring financial stability and recognition for your hard work.
· 20 + 12 holidays : Providing ample time to recharge and spend quality moments with loved ones.
· Laptop and smartphone : Equipping you with the necessary tools to excel in your role, regardless of location.
· Hospitalization insurance and extensive group insurance package : Prioritizing your health and well-being, so you can focus on what matters most.
· Bonus program : Recognizing and rewarding your exceptional contributions to the team's success.
· Training & learning opportunities : Encouraging continuous growth and skill development to reach your full potential.
· Green mobility program : Supporting environmentally friendly commuting options like e-bikes, public transport, bike 2 work allowance, and more.
· Flexrewards : Empowering you to customize your rewards package with our flexible benefits tool to suit your individual needs.
· Discount program : Offering discounts at your favorite (online) shops, so you can enjoy life outside of work.
· Employee shares purchase plan : Providing an opportunity to become a stakeholder in the company's success.
· Eco-cheques : Promoting sustainable living and environmentally conscious choices.
· And many more !

Description of Role and Practice
We are looking for our future leaders today to help leading insurance companies to shape their digital strategy and business transformation and help them on their journey to grow their business and stay relevant for their customers. As part of the team, you will be working for some of the biggest insurance companies with a variety of project opportunities such as business transformation, digitalization, data and analytics and process design.
Responsibilities
· Advise our insurance clients on strategy and digitalization
· Lead and manage project teams, ensure successful delivery of projects, delivery of value-driven recommendations, knowledge transfer and effective advisory
· Develop, define, and implement strategies to help our clients solve their most critical problems within insurance, such as digital transformations, process governance and regulatory requirements

· Be engaged in various projects with wide range of topics, from strategy to execution

· Jenni Saarnio - Management Consulting Manager, LinkedIn profile
· Aleksi Virtanen - Management Consulting Manager, LinkedIn profile

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a relevant field, such as business, finance, economics
· 3-8 years of full-time working experience, either from a position within an insurance company or from another consultancy practice.
· Passion and drive to work with the insurance industry
· Entrepreneurial attitude, and good interpersonal skills
· Good analytical and problem-solving skills
· Project management experience from Business or IT related change projects
· Experience with Guidewire is highly appreciated
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Finnish and English

· Collaboration with Nordics and Netherlands network of talented, passionate colleagues and experts within your field of interest
· Mentoring and continuous evaluation that ensure your career continues to progress

· Access to comprehensive tools and frameworks supported by our global organization
· Extensive education programs and development opportunities
· Volunteering opportunities locally and around the world
· A diverse and socially active workforce
· Benefit package with competitive salary, bonus, pension, health insurance, employee stock purchase program and other benefits
· Flexible work arrangements for maintaining work-life balance
Interested? Make your move – apply online and attach your CV and letter of application in English. We look forward to receiving your application.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.
We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.
“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO
As a team:
Our National Security team is a successful, growing and high-performing part of our Public Sector Strategy & Consulting practice. Within the practice, you will work on innovative projects with colleagues and clients to drive excellence from strategy through to implementation, making changes that directly impact citizens. You will be using the latest technologies and methodologies with clients to help them achieve tangible outcomes and accelerate value.
We work closely with cutting-edge research and development, major hyperscalers, and leading technology players, bringing the best of Accenture’s partnerships and innovation ecosystem to solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Do you want to work in an environment that is cutting-edge, collaborative and challenging, doing work that really matters?
You'll learn, grow and advance in a collaborative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. At Accenture, you can truly take control of your own career.
If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you.
In our team you will learn:
· How to develop and deliver solutions to real world problems, partnering with clients to achieve positive outcomes through collaboration
· How to maximise the use of data in everything you do, using this data to drive solutions and tell meaningful stories to our clients
· How to lead with user-centricity at the heart of our work
As a Management Consultant, you will:
· Work on projects to transform the Workforce across our National Security clients
· Lead complex, people-centric transformation workstreams to drive business change, integrating across large multi-disciplinary programme teams and providing leadership on the people side of the solution/ implementation.
· Be the face of Accenture to the client in your engagements, working with senior stakeholders to advise, challenge and coach as needed
· Develop detailed understanding of your client’s business and drive issue-based discussions grounded in a clear understanding of client challenges and barriers.
· Cultivate trust-based client relationships
· Identify and address client business issues through root cause analysis and by applying pragmatic, results-driven problem-solving techniques and creative insights.
· Use a human-centred approach to solve problems, frame opportunities, and achieve innovation through collaboration and co-creation
· Contribute to business development and sales, working with account teams to scope opportunities and developing compelling proposals to win new work
We are looking for experience in the following skills:
The most important thing for us is that you display the right attitude. We would like you to actively contribute to our community and clients as practitioners, grow our practice, think logically to tackle problems and engage others. We want you to be driven to develop yourself and others, an ability to see and articulate the bigger picture of how individual projects and deliverables create value for citizens and a passion for innovation and the latest technology trends. This role will require creative thinking, excellent client communication skills and the ability to identify new innovative ways to apply our skills and services to solve a wider set of client problems.
As well as the above, you should have experience in more than one of the following areas:
· A minimum of 2-5 years’ people consulting experience in a National Security environment
· Analytical problem-solving skills and continuous improvement techniques
· Strategic thinking skills and the ability to bring insight to complex problems
· Designing and/or implementing operating models/ organisation design
· Change management
· Leadership Development
· Culture Advisory
· Workforce Transformation
· Experience of working with National Security clients
· Experience identifying growth opportunities
· Ability to operate at all stages of a project/programme lifecycle, from proposal through to full programme delivery, and experience managing risks and working with senior client partners.
· Working with data in the design or delivery of consulting services in National Security
· Working with technology to design or deliver transformation in National Security
· Strong interpersonal skills
Set yourself apart:
· In-depth understanding of the National Security landscapes you have worked in
· Experience in owning and managing relationships with leadership (either with your clients or internal stakeholders)
· Trained in Change Management or Agile methodologies, programme or project management techniques (e.g. Prince 2, Managing Successful Programmes) and/or a Design Thinking practitioner
· Exposure to a current technology (e.g. a Cloud platform, a CRM platform)
· PowerPoint and Excel skills
What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!
Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jd_text:
Are you ready to be a part of the AI reinvention of industry and revolutionize your career?
In today’s world, our mission for AI reinvention is to be the leading reinvention partner for global enterprises by building a strong digital core and unleashing artificial intelligence to create 360° value at speed.
That’s where the Advanced Data & AI Center comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, data and AI practitioners, and technology specialists to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention.
Within the Global Center for AI & Data , the AI Trust, Ethics, and Safety team governs pre-deployment ethics and post-deployment operational oversight of AI systems. You will work with multidisciplinary teams to help organizations design, govern, and operate AI systems that are trustworthy, compliant, and fit for deployment across regulated and high-stakes environments.
WORK YOU’LL DO
As part of the Global Center for AI & Data , you will support clients in building the governance structures, regulatory frameworks, and operational controls needed to deploy AI responsibly.
As a Responsible AI Specialist , you will work at the intersection of AI governance, regulatory compliance, and AI system lifecycle management, helping clients translate regulatory obligations into implementable controls and embed responsible AI practices across their AI programmes.
You will work across AI regulatory compliance, AI risk methodology, governance operating model design, regulatory obligation mapping, and AI literacy, supporting both the design of governance frameworks and their integration into live AI development and deployment processes.
There will never be a typical day, and you will continuously learn and grow while working on innovative Data & AI initiatives across industries.
Key Responsibilities
· Map client AI systems against AI regulatory requirements, including prohibited practice identification, high-risk classification, conformity assessment obligations, and Article 4 AI literacy requirements.
· Design and implement AI governance operating models, including RACI structures, lifecycle gates, escalation pathways, and accountability frameworks tailored to the client’s organizational structure.
· Conduct AI risk assessments using structured methodologies, covering technical, legal, ethical, and operational risk dimensions across ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI systems.
· Support ISO/IEC 42001 readiness assessments and implementation planning, including gap analysis, controls design, and preparation for third-party certification.
· Develop regulatory obligation registers and translate them into actionable compliance requirements mapped to AI system components, roles, and processes.
· Configure and use AI governance platforms including IBM watsonx.governance, Credo AI, OneTrust, and ServiceNow to operationalize monitoring, audit trails, and compliance documentation.
· Design and deliver AI literacy programmes addressing Article 4 obligations, including role-based training content, competency frameworks, and delivery mechanisms.
· Support proposal development, client workshops, and governance design sessions as a technical subject matter contributor.
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
· Bachelor’s degree in Law, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A Master’s degree or relevant postgraduate qualification is considered an advantage.
· 3+ years of relevant experience in AI governance, regulatory compliance, risk management, or a related area, with demonstrated hands-on exposure to AI system lifecycle practices and data or software engineering environments.
· Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, including its classification framework, conformity assessment requirements, and obligations for providers and deployers.
· Hands-on experience with one or more AI governance platforms: IBM watsonx.governance, Credo AI, OneTrust, ServiceNow, or SAS.
· Understanding of AI risk methodology applicable to ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI systems, including bias assessment, transparency requirements, and human oversight controls.
· Experience with agentic AI, including context engineering, agent memory patterns, or multi-agent solutions.
· Working knowledge of cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure) as they relate to AI system deployment and governance controls.
· Programming skills in Python, with experience integrating APIs and processing structured and unstructured information.
· Knowledge of GDPR and its intersection with AI system obligations, including data minimization, purpose limitation, and automated decision-making requirements.
· Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into operational controls and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
CONSIDERED A PLUS
· Experience with enterprise metadata and catalog platforms such as Alation, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, or Informatica.
· Familiarity with data modelling and data architecture principles, with exposure to cloud data platforms
· Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 and its application to AI management system design and implementation.
· IAPP AIGP certification or active pursuit of it.
· ISO/IEC 42001 familiarity.
· Familiarity with DORA obligations as they apply to AI-driven financial systems.
· Experience with BPM tooling (Camunda) or workflow automation in compliance contexts.
· Relevant AI or cloud certifications, including Azure AI Fundamentals, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or equivalent.
· Exposure to security analysis practices (SAST, DAST, SCA) as applied to AI system assurance.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
· Competitive salary and benefits, including but not limited to: life/health insurance, performance based bonuses, monthly vouchers, company car (depending on management level), flexible work arrangements, employee share purchase plan, TEA Accenture, parental leave, paid overtime (if needed) and various corporate discounts
· Access to enterprise AI development tooling and the internal community building with it
· Continuous hard and soft skills training & development through global platforms & local academy, including cloud certification paths (Azure, GCP)
· Career coaching and mentorship to help you manage your career and develop professionally
· Ongoing strengths and skills based evaluation process
· Various opportunities to develop your career across a spectrum of clients, industries and projects
· Diverse and inclusive culture
· Corporate citizenship initiatives (access to volunteering opportunities, charity work etc.)
· Under our Brain Regain initiative, extra relocation benefits may apply
To learn more about Accenture, and how you will be challenged and inspired from Day 1, please visit our website accenture.com/gr-en/.

Career Level 9: Consultant

Do you want to contribute to work with meaningful impact and help Ireland achieve its sustainability and energy transition goals? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you! Join us in driving climate action and working on new and innovative solutions to meet the challenges of today and tomorrow.
Ireland's Utilities sector is at the heart of the energy transition, and the decisions being made now on networks, renewables, markets and customers will shape the country for decades. As a Consultant in Accenture's Utilities practice, you'll work on nationally significant engagements with Ireland's leading energy, gas and water organisations. You'll help them decarbonise, invest in resilient infrastructure and deliver more sustainable, affordable services, while building and developing a high-performing team.
Apply now and become an integral part of the movement towards a cleaner, greener future.
Accenture Utilities
At Accenture, we deliver end-to-end solutions that drive real change for organisations. You'll work on innovative projects with dedicated colleagues, using the latest technologies and innovations to help clients achieve their goals, from digital disruption to sustainable net-zero transition. As part of our global network, you'll use a broad range of expertise to tackle our clients' most ambitious problems and directly contribute to the energy transition. We'll support your continuous development of market-relevant knowledge, advisory, and technical skills, challenging you to take on new initiatives and push the boundaries of what's possible.
Join our Utilities Industry Practice within Industry & Enterprise, where we help Ireland's leading utilities companies achieve their climate action targets. Bring your passion and experience to deliver ground-breaking projects, whether in electricity power system operations or sophisticated program delivery. You'll support clients with a range of services, from industry consulting, strategic direction, to process improvement and technology transformations, while building your skills and driving energy transition goals.
Job Description:
As a Consultant in Utilities, you will play a key role in delivering impactful advisory and transformation engagements for Ireland's leading energy and utilities organisations. A key element of your role is to apply deep sector and delivery experience of power system planning, network operations and grid infrastructure alongside strong analytical capability to diagnose client challenges, develop practical recommendations, and support their implementation. Working closely with client stakeholders, you will build trusted relationships, provide strategic guidance, and contribute to solutions that address complex challenges across grid stability, network capacity and the infrastructure requirements of the energy transition. You will work as part of cross-functional teams, contributing to workstream delivery and ensuring outcomes are aligned to client goals and the broader energy transition agenda.
Key Responsibilities:
· Support the delivery of strategic initiatives for utilities clients, helping to meet their decarbonisation, resilience and sustainability objectives.
· Support the delivery of high-quality consulting engagements and transformation programmes across the utilities sector.
· Contribute to and collaborate within multi-functional project teams, coordinating workstream activities across the engagement lifecycle.
· Apply expertise in power system planning, network analysis and grid operations to support the design and implementation of solutions for utilities clients.
· Support resource planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities within the context of the engagement or programme
· Contribute to integrated project and programme planning, ensuring coherent workstream coordination across engagements.
· Identify and escalate risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, supporting their effective management throughout the engagement.
· Prepare and present clear, structured analysis, and insights for client and internal stakeholders.
· Collaborate with client teams, subject matter experts, and colleagues across business, technology, and operations functions to ensure alignment on goals and outcomes.
· Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, developing a deep understanding of their challenges to ensure our recommendations and solutions address their needs.
· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, bringing fresh thinking to enhance the efficiency, quality, and impact of client engagements.
· Continuously develop and maintain deep expertise across the utilities sector to provide informed guidance to clients and contribute to Accenture’s utilities thought leadership.
· Support business development activities including solution scoping, proposal development, and client presentations to help grow Accenture's utilities practice.
Desired skillset: ·
· Experience working within or consulting to the utilities sector.
· Experience in delivery of complex projects or programmes within a power systems, grid infrastructure, or network operations environment. ·
· Knowledge of power systems operations, including transmission network design, grid stability and system balancing. ·
· Familiarity with grid connection processes, network codes and regulatory frameworks. ·
· Excellent communication, and interpersonal skills. ·
· Ability to communicate findings and status to a non-technical audience. ·
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. ·
· Experience leveraging AI and data-driven tools to analyse complex problems, generate insights, or develop solutions that drive measurable value for clients.
· Experience working independently and in diverse teams.
· Focus on continuous development and curiosity about the latest industry and technology trends.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE : ·
· Relevant undergraduate/master’s degree in a business, engineering, technical or economic field.
· 4-7 years of relevant utility proven experience in power system planning, network operations, grid infrastructure, or a related technical discipline, or 3-5 years in a consulting role, with experience in power systems or network transformation engagements.
· Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment across a wide variety of projects and roles to deliver for our clients.
· Ability to build lasting relationships with clients and colleagues.

jd_text:
Technology Strategy and Transformation (TS&T) Consultant
Location: Dublin
Career Level: 9 (Specialist/Consultant)
About TS&T Ireland
Technology Strategy and Transformation (TS&T) a key part of our growing Digital Core service. Here, we develop company-wide IT and digitalisation strategies that exploit ground-breaking technologies and strategically advise our Fortune 500 CIO clients on how to reinvent their IT operating models, enterprise and data architectures, take advantage of cloud, and improve the value they are getting from their IT investments. Our practice has been consistently rated as the best team in the industry by the Financial Times based on client ratings and was key for Accenture to be named a leader by Forrester .
The Opportunity for You
We are looking for a motivated technology and business consulting professional to join our growing Technology Strategy and Transformation practice. This role is suited to candidates who want to build their experience helping clients shape and deliver technology-led reinvention across the Digital Core. You will work alongside experienced consultants and industry specialists while developing your own expertise across technology strategy, AI enablement, architecture, digital foundations and transformation delivery.
This role is suited to candidates who bring a strong consulting foundation and experience across several areas of technology strategy, architecture, AI enablement, digital foundations, technology effectiveness, and transformation delivery.
We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every area; we value thoughtful generalists who can connect business priorities, technology choices, delivery realities, and measurable value outcomes while continuing to be curious about learning.
In this role, you will help clients define, shape and deliver technology products, platforms, operating models and transformation programmes that unlock business value, improve agility and accelerate outcomes. You will work closely with client stakeholders, business and industry specialists, engineering teams, architects, designers, analysts, partner vendors and delivery teams to create practical, high-quality outcomes.
What you will help clients do:
· Support and drive strategic advisory projects, programmes and workstreams from shaping through to delivery, keeping stakeholders aligned, informed and focused on outcomes.
· Help clients define how technology functions can create business value through effective operating models, product and platform structures, governance, organisation design and ways of working.
· Contribute to developing transformation strategies, business cases and roadmaps that are pragmatic, actionable and linked to measurable value
· Assess current-state maturity across areas such as architecture, agile delivery, modern engineering, operating models, governance, AI readiness and technology ways of working.
· Support the assessment of AI and emerging technology opportunities on how these will impact IT operation modes, architectures and transformation deliveries
· Guide practical adoption of AI in the software development lifecycle, helping teams reduce delivery cost, improve engineering effectiveness and accelerate time to value.
· Provide clear updates on progress, risks, issues, actions and dependencies to support effective decision-making.
What you will do:
· Work with business and technology leaders to define technology strategies, future-state roadmaps, and practical transformation plans.
· Help clients build AI-ready digital foundations across data, cloud, infrastructure, platforms, enterprise architecture, and modern delivery practices.
· Assess technology estates, operating models, delivery capabilities, resilience, cost, and value to identify opportunities for improvement.
· Support complex transformation programmes by helping teams establish governance, manage risk, track value, and maintain delivery momentum.
· Collaborate across business, technology, data, engineering, infrastructure, managed services, and ecosystem partners to create joined-up solutions.
· Conduct research, analysis and assessments to support technology strategy and transformation engagements.
· Develop presentations, reports, business cases and recommendations for client stakeholders.
· Support workshops, stakeholder interviews and working sessions.
· Gather and analyse information to identify opportunities, risks and improvement actions.
· Work with multidisciplinary teams to translate strategy into actionable outcomes.
Experience Requirements:
· Solid experience in consulting, technology strategy or technology transformation teams ( typically 3+ years ).
· Proven track record supporting technology programmes.
· Experience managing client relationships and stakeholders.
Core skills we expect everyone to bring:
· AI awareness and curiosity: a practical understanding of how AI, data, and automation are changing businesses, technology functions, and delivery methods.
· Strong communication and storytelling: the ability to explain complex ideas clearly, tailor messages for different audiences, and build confidence with stakeholders.
· Project and change skills: experience helping teams plan, organise, govern, and deliver change in complex environments.
· Business and technology judgement: the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, value, risk, cost, and feasibility.
· Collaboration and adaptability: comfort working across multidisciplinary teams, learning new domains quickly, and contributing beyond a narrow specialism.
· Structured problem solving: the ability to break down ambiguity, identify options, build evidence-based recommendations, and move work forward.
Experience across several of these areas:
Candidates should bring experience in some of the areas below and demonstrate a willingness to build broader capability across multiple domains. These are the kinds of things our teams do; they are not all mandatory requirements for every candidate.
· Technology strategy and architecture: shaping technology vision, business technology strategy, enterprise architecture, future-state roadmaps, and investment cases.
· AI, data, and digital foundations: supporting AI adoption, data strategy, agentic or AI-enabled platforms, cloud and infrastructure strategies, enterprise SaaS, and modern digital core design.
· Technology modernisation and resilience: assessing legacy estates, defining modernisation pathways, improving resilience, and sequencing practical architecture roadmaps.
· Technology effectiveness and value: improving technology operating models, FinOps, cost optimisation, AI-enabled software delivery, engineering productivity, and value tracking.
· Transformation delivery: supporting large-scale technology programmes, transformation offices, governance, planning, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realisation.
· Ecosystem and platform collaboration: working with major technology platforms, cloud providers, software vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams to shape integrated solutions.
Who will thrive in this role:
· Generalists who enjoy connecting ideas across strategy, architecture, delivery, AI, data, operating model, and business value.
· People who are comfortable with ambiguity and can help clients move from broad ambition to practical next steps.
· Consultants who are comfortable working collaboratively with clients and teams, communicating clearly and contributing positively to shared outcomes
· Candidates with curiosity , learning agility, and the confidence to contribute across several areas while deepening expertise over time.
Important note on requirements
This is intentionally not a checklist of mandatory must-haves. We expect candidates to demonstrate the core consulting, communication, AI awareness, project, and change skills described above, and to bring meaningful experience across several of the capability areas. We welcome candidates who can learn quickly, collaborate broadly, and apply good judgement across a range of client challenges.
#LI-EU

The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .
Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
· Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
· Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.
· Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain. Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
· Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.
· Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
· Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization): Consultant
Direct Materials Spend Optimization
At Accenture, we work across industries to address our client’s most complex challenges, bringing together innovative talent and emerging technologies.
Practice: Strategy & Consulting, Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization)

Locations: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
As part of Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), you will help clients improve EBITDA and build more resilient supply chains by transforming Direct Materials, the supplier facing materials, components and externally manufactured inputs that flow directly into products.
The role combines hands on direct category and analytical experience with engineering led cost transformation, strategic sourcing, supplier ecosystem design, digital/ AI enablement, and disciplined value realization. You will support work across the full Direct Materials agenda what to buy, where to buy, who to buy from, for how much, how and when to buy, and how to sustain value.
What you will work on
· Direct Materials diagnostics and value assessments: Support spend/category baselining, analyse cost drivers and help size opportunities using spend, BOM, supplier, specification, and operational data.
· undefined
· Should-costing, teardowns & Design-to-Value: Build and refine bottom-up should cost models using BOMs, drawings/ CAD, material and process inputs; support product/component teardowns and competitive benchmarking; identify value through VA/VE, specification optimization, part/ SKU standardization, make vs buy and complexity reduction.
· undefined
· Strategic sourcing and commercial excellence: Support category strategy development, competitive sourcing, fact-based negotiations, contract optimization, commodity intelligence, price risk/hedging and total cost of ownership interventions; incorporate sustainability into overall strategies.
· undefined
· Supplier ecosystem and resilience: Support best country sourcing, localization, alternate supplier discovery, supplier consolidation, dual/multi-sourcing, supply network optimization, and risk mitigation.
· undefined
· AI/ Agentic Direct Procurement: Support the design, testing and deployment of practical AI/ GenAI/ Agentic use cases across spend analytics, should cost modelling, supplier discovery, commodity and market intelligence, guided negotiation, complexity reduction, tariff intelligence, and Source to Pay workflows.
· undefined
· Value realization and sustainment: Support translation of opportunities into business cases, execution roadmaps, contracted savings, supplier performance mechanisms, operating-model improvements, and managed-service/ continuous-improvement models.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role
· Strong analytical problem solving with the ability to connect commercial, engineering, supply chain and financial data.
· Ability to work across Procurement, Engineering/ R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance and Technology stakeholders.
· Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management and teamwork skills.
· Comfort with digital, analytics and emerging AI technologies, with a practical focus on measurable business outcomes. Role Details
Support client value creation
· Understand the client business, product economics, direct material cost base, priorities and value agenda.
· Support client discussions and contribute to transformation strategies spanning cost, margin, resilience, productivity and AI-enabled procurement.
· Build credibility with client and functional stakeholders through strong industry/category understanding and fact-based insights. Support program delivery
· Support Direct Materials engagements from rapid diagnostic and value assessment through sourcing, negotiation, implementation and sustained value realization.
· Work with teams across spend/ BOM analytics, should-costing, teardown/value engineering, commodity and market intelligence, sourcing strategy, supplier assessment, risk analysis, business cases and roadmaps.
· Help translate identified opportunities into executable actions, finance aligned benefits and scalable client capabilities. Support business growth and our capabilities
· Contribute to Direct Materials opportunities, client propositions, commercial pathway development and solutioning.
· Collaborate across category, engineering, industry, data/ AI and technology teams to support end-to-end client problem solving.
· Contribute to reusable assets, playbooks and points of view across Direct Materials transformation and Agentic AI.
Preferred industry and category experience
· Industries: CPG, Industrial & Automotive, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, High Tech, Retail, Health & Life Sciences, Metals & Mining industry experience would be preferred
· Categories: Metals/ steel/ alloys/ castings; plastics and resins; electronics/ PCBs/ components; chemicals; packaging; food ingredients/ agri commodities; pulp & paper; mining equipment/ consumables; contract manufacturing; and other product-critical direct categories.
· Experience supporting consulting and/or global/ multi-country transformation programs is desirable.
· Experience supporting cross-functional teams and engaging client stakeholders across consulting or transformation programs.
· Working knowledge of Excel and visualization/ analytics tools such as Power BI/ Alteryx; exposure to AI/ GenAI/ Agentic AI solutions in procurement is desirable. What's in it for you?
· Opportunity to work on high impact Direct Materials transformation programs for leading global clients, with a direct line of sight to COGS, EBITDA and supply resilience.
· Work at the intersection of procurement, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, data and AI moving from strategy through implementation and value realization.
· Build deep expertise across direct categories, should-costing, Design to Value, supplier ecosystems and AI-enabled/Agentic procurement solutions.
· Collaborate with strategy leaders, industry specialists, engineers, data/AI practitioners and global delivery teams to create differentiated client outcomes.
· Access structured learning and development to deepen consulting, category, technology and client-facing capabilities in a globally connected environment.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance services creating tangible value at speed and scale. Our Strategy & Consulting teams combine industry, functional, technology and delivery expertise to help clients reinvent how they operate and compete.
Within Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), our Direct Materials work brings together deep category expertise, engineering and product-cost capabilities, strategic sourcing, AI / Agentic assets and global delivery to drive measurable and sustainable client value.
About Accenture Strategy & Consulting
Accenture Strategy & Consulting works with clients on their most critical business and operating model challenges, combining deep business insight with technology and data. Global Network teams complement in-country teams to deliver specialized expertise and measurable value across the client lifecycle.
At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.
Your experience counts!
· MBA from a Tier-1 business school, or equivalent relevant postgraduate qualification.
· Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Supply Chain or a related field from a reputed institution.
· 3-8 years of relevant experience for Analyst/Consultant level , with hands on exposure to Direct Materials procurement, sourcing, category management, product cost management, and/or manufacturing cost transformation.
· Relevant hands-on experience in one or more direct-material value levers: should cost modelling, product/component teardowns, Design to Value/ VA-VE, specification/complexity reduction, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, commodity buying/hedging, supplier ecosystem design, localization or supply risk management.
· Experience working with technical inputs such as BOMs, drawings/CAD, material specifications, supplier quotes and manufacturing process/cost drivers is strongly preferred.

Job Summary
Practice: I&P | Global Network - SONG | Areas of Work: Marketing Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation, Future-State Marketing Process Design, Marketing Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.
As a Consultant, you will help clients reimagine how marketing work gets done across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, content, media, CRM, social, search, and measurement through process redesign, digital innovation, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered ways of working. Operating at the intersection of customer experience, marketing, analytics, technology, and operations, you will lead workstreams, conduct capability and process assessments, define future-state processes and operating models, shape transformation roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes that improve growth, customer value, and operational effectiveness.
You Are
You are a hands-on marketing transformation leader who can take ownership of a client workstream from diagnostic through future-state design. You combine practical knowledge of how modern marketing functions operate with structured process excellence methods, and you can translate business priorities into clear process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, and adoption requirements.
You design at the intersection of marketer, AI agent, platform, and process. You apply Agent Experience (AX) Design principles to determine where AI agents can support or automate work, where human judgment is essential, and how roles, controls, escalation, and handoffs should be designed to improve speed, quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
Roles & Responsibilities
Use AI tools across research, analysis, design, and deliverable creation, and identify opportunities to embed AI and agentic solutions into redesigned marketing processes. As a Consultant, you will be expected to independently lead workstreams, facilitate client discussions, and convert analysis into implementation-ready recommendations. Your responsibilities include:
Marketing Transformation & Benchmarking
● Assess marketing trends, customer and channel shifts, and peer practices to identify process reinvention opportunities across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, campaign planning, content operations, media, CRM/lifecycle marketing, social and influencer marketing, search, marketing operations, and measurement.
● Lead capability and process diagnostics and benchmarking to identify performance gaps, pain points, control issues, duplication, and opportunities to improve productivity, speed-to-market, customer experience, marketing effectiveness, and cost efficiency.
● Build data-driven assessments and executive-ready insights using AI-assisted analysis and visualization tools, translating findings into clear transformation priorities.
Future-State Marketing Process Design
● Lead future-state marketing process and operating model design covering AI integration points, workflow automation, decision rights, governance, human-machine interaction, platform enablement, measurement, and workforce adoption.
● Lead client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; facilitate co-creation across marketing, content, media, CRM, analytics, technology, and operations teams; and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
● Connect future-state marketing processes to MarTech/AdTech platforms and delivery realities so that transformation designs are practical, scalable, measurable, and ready for implementation.
Operating Model, Change & Adoption
● Develop change-impact assessments covering roles, skills, governance, ways of working, service delivery, and adoption implications created by redesigned marketing processes.
● Build and maintain marketing process playbooks, redesign methods, benchmarks, and reusable assets; contribute to proposals and thought leadership; and coach junior practitioners on marketing process excellence and operating model design.
AI & AX Design Application
● Embed Agent Experience (AX) Design principles into marketing process specifications by defining AI agent roles, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, controls, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoffs within redesigned workflows.
● Identify practical agentic use cases across marketing planning, insight generation, content and campaign operations, optimization, measurement, and reporting, with appropriate controls and governance.
Professional & Technical Skills
● 2-8 years of experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting, with increasing independence across engagements.
● Demonstrated ability to lead client workstreams, conduct capability and current-state process assessments, facilitate workshops, and present future-state recommendations to senior stakeholders.
● Strong understanding of marketing operating models and processes across two or more areas such as campaign management, content operations, media, CRM, social and influencer marketing, search, MarTech, or measurement.
● Working knowledge of how AI, automation, and agentic solutions can be integrated into marketing processes, including operating model and governance implications.
● Experience with process mapping, benchmarking, change-impact analysis, and business case development; ability to translate data into structured, business-ready recommendations.
● Strong communication, workshop facilitation, and client relationship skills, with the ability to explain complex process, AI, data, and technology choices in business terms.
● Ability to connect customer and growth outcomes with marketing process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, measurement, and adoption requirements.
● Experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments and managing multiple workstreams with client-facing accountability.
● Experience contributing to business development, proposal/RFP development, reusable assets, or thought leadership, and coaching junior practitioners, is preferred.
Additional Information
● Experience in consumer-led B2C industries is strongly preferred, including Consumer Goods & Services, Retail, Life Sciences, Automotive, Travel, Communications & Media, or similar sectors with scaled marketing operations.
● Familiarity with process mapping or process mining tools such as Visio, Signavio, ARIS, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
● Exposure to MarTech/AdTech ecosystems such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce, Sprinklr, Google Marketing Platform, or comparable enterprise platforms is desirable.
● Applied knowledge of Agent Experience (AX) Design principles - including agent autonomy, handoffs, escalation, controls, and human oversight - is preferred.
● Strong analytical skills and ability to connect process improvements to measurable marketing outcomes such as productivity, speed-to-market, engagement, conversion, ROI, or customer experience.
● Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI, agentic marketing, automation, marketing operating models, and emerging digital marketing practices.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world's largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 774,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives.

2-8 years of relevant experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

jd_text:
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept-to-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.
You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision-making .
Digital Thread
Digital Thread focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept-to-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real-time, data-driven decision making.
· Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
· Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept-to-service process integration.
· Current-state assessments and future-state operating model design that improve end-to-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision-making across the value chain. Connected Twins
Connected Twins build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.
· Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end-to-end supply chains.
· Simulation-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
· Process architecture and future-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

You will help clients translate strategic ambitions into measurable business outcomes by leveraging technology, AI, data, and new ways of working. You'll play a key part in helping clients optimize operations, achieve growth, and strategically position themselves for the future energy market, while continuously developing your skills and expertise.
The appropriate employment level will be determined as part of the recruitment process, in consultation with the candidate.
Key responsibilities include:

· Drive innovation: Apply AI, data, analytics, and emerging technologies to help clients improve operations, enhance decision-making, accelerate project execution, and unlock new sources of business value.

· Facilitate workshops and deliver insights: Conduct workshops and presentations, develop business cases, and provide strategic recommendations that help clients address key challenges and opportunities.
· Be a trusted advisor: Guide clients through the energy transition and help them navigate changing industry dynamics, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies.
· Support business growth: Identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, and contribute to proposal development and business development activities for future projects.

· Supporting an energy company in redesigning its operating model and organizational setup to improve efficiency, enhance agility, and support strategic priorities.
· Helping clients define and implement AI- and data-enabled transformation initiatives to improve business performance and accelerate value realization.
What's in it for you?
· Competitive salary, attractive bonus schemes, occupational pension schemes, share savings programme, and enhanced parental leave benefits.
· Professional development including your own personal budget for skills development, access to training, certifications, conferences, and other learning activities.
· Monthly community meetings with a focus on personal and professional development.
· Larger and smaller social gatherings such as payday parties and annual celebrations.
· A wide range of sports and interest groups, including football, running, mountain sports and skiing.
· Access to a global network of industry and specialist knowledge.
· An inclusive working environment with inspiring and skilled colleagues and leaders.
· Flexible working hours prioritizing work-life balance.
· Overtime pay options for Analyst & Consultant level.
We believe you have:
· Master's degree with strong academic results in a relevant field, such as finance, industrial economics, economics, change management, business administration, engineering, mathematics, or other relevant disciplines.
· 2–5 years of experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, business transformation, technology advisory, or relevant experience from the Energy, Utilities, and Renewables industries.
· Understanding of the Energy, Utilities and Renewables value chain, industry dynamics, and key trends impacting the sector.
· Experience collaborating in cross-functional and global teams and thriving in creative problem-solving environments.
· Excellent communication skills in Norwegian and English, both written and verbal. As many of our client engagements are conducted in Norwegian, professional working proficiency in Norwegian is mandatory for success in the role.

· Interest in AI, data, innovative solutions, and digital transformation.
· Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

The position will report to the Managing Director for the Nordic Energy Industries, and the workplace is either Oslo or Stavanger, Norway.

Apply online by attaching your CV, application letter, and educational diplomas as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application!

The role
You will work with Accenture teams and clients on shaping and executing strategic transformation programme for large businesses and government departments. As a Consultant you will be responsible for work across programmes that include process redesign, AI and system implementation, and business transformation, among others. You will support Accenture leaders on complex transformation programmes, helping clients simplify, redesign, and implement improved ways of working, often leveraging technology and AI in how you do the work and in how teams’ work will be transformed. You will translate business problems into practical transformation plans, combining process redesign, operating model change, AI/automation, data and technology implementation, and value realisation. You will be accountable for delivering quality analysis, supporting client and Accenture teams as needed, tracking value and benefits (how do our clients get return on investment from the work we do together), and ensuring our recommendations are practical, implementable, and aligned to client strategy.
Using your skills and industry knowledge, you will guide our clients towards a well-defined target state while effectively managing change at scale. You will make use of your industry and technology competence e.g., in transformation, AI, Cloud, Data or Security to build rapport with stakeholders in both business and technology functions and facilitate quick and effective decisions. Your key focus will be on preparing high quality analysis, project management, and solving problems together with the engagement teams you join.

· Analysis : Analyse client data, processes, operating models and performance issues to identify areas for improvement. Define and track value realisation measures, such as productivity, cost, customer experience, employee experience, risk reduction and other financial and non-financial outcome
· Programme management : Manage day-to-day delivery across Accenture and client teams, including planning, issue resolution, stakeholder alignment and decision support
· Executive problem solving : Prepare clear executive-level materials, recommendations and business cases for senior client stakeholders

· Adaptability : The role requires a flexible and adaptable nature

· Relevant Bachelor's Degree or equivalent industry experience
· Minimum 3 years of experience in a professional services organisation, working alongside key senior stakeholders, modelling and supporting transformation journeys, and delivering strategic proposals.
EXPERTISE:
Depth:
· Typically has a minimum of 3 to 8 years of experience doing similar work either at or outside of Accenture
· Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge in an area of expertise based on experience

· Expected to be knowledgeable about the work performed by their immediate team and teams they collaborate with
DECISION MAKING:

· Typically receives direction and feedback from their supervisor on setting priorities or assigning and managing tasks on a weekly to bi-weekly basis
· Expected consequences for mistakes in their work would include missing team deadlines and may be escalated to a managing director
· Involved in risk mitigation decisions for multiple teams
Authority:
· Responsible for decisions that apply across multiple teams, and expected to contribute to business area decisions
SCOPE:

Complexity:

Span:

About the Role
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations navigate complexity, drive reinvention, and create sustainable value.
The Role will be part of Macro Foresight - an Accenture's CEO Advisory business. We work with CEOs and boards on enterprise-wide strategy and reinvention, helping them perform, protect, and grow. Within that, we are the team that anticipates disruption and volatility: we help clients read the external environment - economic, geopolitical, and financial - and build long-term strategies for competitiveness and resilience. Our footprint is global, with hubs in North America, Europe, and Asia.
In the past two years we've helped leaders respond to the highest US tariffs in a century, energy and supply shocks around the Strait of Hormuz, two-speed economies, and the reordering of global trade around industrial policy and AI.
What we do
The work we deliver for client’s centers on a set of CEO- and board-level offerings:
· Economic and geopolitical impact assessments. AI-accelerated analysis of how macro and geopolitical shifts affect a business, a market, or a major investment.
· Scenario planning and wargaming. AI-enabled planning and table-top wargaming that test a strategy against a range of possible futures.
· Decision intelligence. Enterprise-wide decision support that reaches beyond macro and geopolitics into portfolio strategy, competition, consumer trends, and business performance.
· Strategic foresight and long-range planning. Structured futures assessments and long-range portfolio planning.
· Enterprise resilience assessments. CEO- and board-level diagnostics that measure and strengthen an organization's resilience to shocks.
· Foresight capability enablement. Helping clients build their own capability across people, process, and technology.
The people we hire
We hire for a few different profiles, and many people here bring more than one:
· Economists and geopolitical experts who read the real economy, financial and commodity markets, and the interplay of policy, trade, and security, and apply it to a client's business context.
· Strategists who translate complex analysis into recommendations a leadership team can act on.
· Entrepreneurial people who grow teams and develop those who join after them.
· AI engineers who code, build models, and put large language models and AI agents to work. We're actively hiring for this.
· People who work well with ambiguity , set their own direction, and want to help build new offerings like scenario planning, wargaming, and foresight.
Based in our Singapore hub, you'll work on the questions reshaping the Asia Pacific region: supply-chain reconfiguration, China's changing role, geopolitical tensions, and the new industrial forces driving growth in the region. You'll help multinationals, regional companies, government-linked entities, and investors turn that uncertainty into practical strategy and stronger resilience.
What you'll be doing
· Deliver client engagements. Own a workstream from the first framing of the question through to the recommendation, and stay with it as the client acts on it.
· Work as part of a team. Deliver on small engagement teams, learn from senior colleagues, and help develop those who join after you.
· Build the analysis behind the advice. Create the models, scenarios, dashboards, and data pipelines that turn raw data into clear answers.
· Put AI to work. Use large language models and AI agents to accelerate monitoring, research, and scenario analysis on live projects.
· Help build our offerings and platform. Work with Accenture's AI engineering teams to turn scenario planning, wargaming, and decision intelligence into productized, AI-enabled services, and to develop our AI Foresight platform.
· Sharpen our thinking between engagements. Alongside the client work, contribute to our monthly Macro Briefs and points of view, with the chance over time to publish under your own name.
What we're looking for
· At least 2 years delivering strategy, economics, or advisory work in consulting, corporate development, investment, or research. Including:
· A track record of delivering on client work : running a workstream in a team, hitting deadlines, and holding your own with a client.
· The ability to turn analysis into a decision , drawing out what macro and company data mean for a client's business.
· Demonstrated experience using AI tools to redesign and accelerate workflows, improve research and analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance project delivery.
· A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience .
What will make you stand out
· A graduate degree in economics, finance, public policy, international relations, or management (or an MBA), or an advanced quantitative, computational, data science, or engineering background.
· Curiosity about macro and geopolitics , with a strong grasp of how the real economy connects to markets, sectors, and regions
· Experience with our core offerings: scenario planning, wargaming, or foresight .
· AI and engineering depth , with priority given to developing AI-enabled analytical solutions: coding in Python and/or R, building models, dashboards, or data pipelines, and applying LLMs and AI agents to analytical workflows .
· Experience communicating with and advising C-suite or board audiences, or depth in a specific industry or region's political economy.
· Familiarity with tools like Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau , or econometrics packages such as Stata or EViews.
The practical details
· Fluency in English is required for this role.
· Proficiency in a regional language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, or Bahasa Indonesia ) is nice to have

Through deep industry expertise , analytics and insights, Accenture Strategy empower s clients to survive and thrive in the new, the now and the unknown. To stay agile in a world dominated by change, the C-suite must keep the core business running while simultaneously identifying and investing in the new. Accenture Strategy consulting enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.
The Accenture Commodity Markets, part of Accenture Strategy, is a global practice operating across multiple industries.
