About Accenture
Accenture helps the world's leading organisations reinvent themselves, building their digital core and putting AI to work to create value at speed. We bring together approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep industry and process expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships. Our Reinvention Services span Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capability in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients in more than 120 countries, with offices and operations in 52 countries and more than 200 cities, and reported revenues of approximately US$70 billion in fiscal 2025. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
About Accenture CEO Advisory
Accenture CEO Advisory works with chief executives, boards and their leadership teams on the decisions that set enterprise direction: where to compete, what to own, how to fund a shift in the portfolio, and what the operating model has to become to support it. The work sits upstream of execution but is judged on whether it survives contact with it, so we pair industry depth with the quantitative, technology and delivery capability to pressure-test an answer before a client commits capital behind it.
About Accenture Commodity Markets
Accenture Commodity Markets (ACM), part of Accenture CEO Advisory, is a global practice operating across multiple industries. It is one of the few global strategy practices offering a steep cross-industry learning curve alongside genuinely global project experience, working with organisations focused on commodity production, trading, logistics and marketing.
We combine industry knowledge across energy, chemicals, soft commodities, agriculture, metals, mining, utilities, transportation and consumer goods with analytics-led core strategy consulting, digital and AI capability.
Within Accenture we are known for the variety and complexity of the problems we take on, a close-knit global team, early responsibility for our people, rapid career progression and international exposure, having delivered projects in over 25 countries.
Our solution areas are:
Investment and Asset Portfolio Optimisation: portfolio strategy, capital allocation, long-term market modelling, M&A support, and integrated optimisation across physical and financial positions. Trading and Market Optimisation: trading strategy, positioning and risk management through advanced analytics, real-time insight, hedging, algorithmic trading and P&L attribution. Commodity Markets Decision Platforms, Ecosystem and Execution: AI-enabled decision platforms, CTRM and ETRM selection, ecosystem partners (Salesforce, Palantir and others), data architecture, AI model development and automation. Enterprise Activation and Operational Readiness: making sure organisations are ready to operate, trade and optimise from day one, covering operating model design, go-live strategy and capability build-out. Commodity Sourcing and Exposure Management: sourcing, hedging and supplier strategy for commodity-exposed industries, optimising cost, risk and resilience under market volatility.
About the Role in Thailand
ACM in Thailand advises state enterprises, listed energy groups and large industrial corporates on decisions that set their direction for the next decade: how to position a portfolio through the energy transition, what gas and power market liberalisation does to a commercial model, whether an asset or an acquisition earns its cost of capital, and how to stand up the trading and commercial capability a deregulated market demands.
Regulatory and transition depth in the Thai and wider ASEAN energy system runs through most of that work. Third-party access regimes, tariff structures, PPA economics and market design are commercial questions for our clients, and we are expected to hold a defensible view on them.
We also build with AI as a matter of course. Market and competitor scans, document-heavy regulatory review and first-cut modelling run with GenAI in the workflow. That changes how much ground a small team can cover, and it raises the bar on what counts as analysis rather than description.
The Thailand team is small and growing. You will own a workstream and its client relationships early, and you will present your own work to client leadership.
Key Responsibilities
Client Delivery and Development
· Lead project workstreams to closure with limited supervision, from framing the question through to the recommendation you defend in front of the client.
· Work on engagements in Thailand and across Southeast Asia, with access to the ACM global staffing pool for projects further afield.
· Work in cross-office teams spanning ACM Thailand and global ACM, bringing structure and quantitative and qualitative rigour to problems across our solution areas.
· Build and own the analysis behind the answer: financial and operational models, market and asset economics, and the numerical modelling of energy and commodity markets.
· Run client interviews and workshops, build the materials, and hold your own in the conversation about approach and recommendation.
· Work across corporate and portfolio strategy, energy transition positioning, market liberalisation and regulatory response, trading and risk capability set-up, operating model design, commercial optimisation, investment valuation and financial structuring, and balance sheet analysis.
· Use GenAI tooling as a default part of how you work, and take responsibility for the quality of what comes out of it.
· Develop client relationships by staying close to how each client actually decides, and stay market relevant through thought leadership and taking fresh ideas to them unprompted. Practice Building
· Contribute to ACM Thailand, global ACM and the wider Accenture CEO Advisory community, and to building ACM offerings, assets and thought leadership.
· Support business development by running industry and company research (competitor and market scanning, market fundamentals, financials, customers) and by building proposal materials.
· Coach analysts on your workstream, on both the analysis and how it is communicated.
Required Experience
· An undergraduate and master's degree from a leading academic institution.
· 3-6 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, or in a relevant commercial, strategy or corporate development role in industry.
· Strong quantitative skills and comfort owning a financial or operational model end to end, including the assumptions and their defensibility.
· Business case development and financial analysis, with fluency reading and interrogating financial statements.
· Structured, hypothesis-led problem solving, and the ability to take a position where the evidence is incomplete and say what would change it.
· Working proficiency with GenAI tools in analytical work, and the judgement to know where their output cannot be trusted.
· Professional fluency in Thai and English, written and spoken.
· Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality output with multicultural teams under short timeframes. Desirable
· AI capability that goes beyond tool use, combined with quantitative modelling and commodity market knowledge.
· Sector exposure in energy, utilities, chemicals, agriculture, or metals and mining.
· Understanding of the Thai and ASEAN energy sector and its regulatory institutions.
· Exposure to commodity trading, risk management, or investment and asset valuation.
· International study or work experience. Location and Working Arrangements
· Based in Bangkok, Thailand.
· Travel across Southeast Asia and, for global staffing, further afield.
· Flexible working arrangements, with the expectation of client site presence where the engagement requires it. Why Join Us
· The Thailand practice is small and in build phase, so you carry real scope from the first engagement and you are visible to practice leadership from the start.
· Direct exposure to C-suite and board-level decisions at some of Thailand's largest energy and industrial groups, on questions where the answer is genuinely open.
· Access to the ACM global staffing pool, so cross-border and cross-industry project experience does not require leaving the practice.
· Continuous coaching from senior colleagues in ACM Thailand and global ACM, with a specialisation path set out deliberately rather than left to whatever staffing throws up.
· Flexible work arrangements and a competitive rewards package. Next Steps

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our Utilities CFO & Enterprise Value Practice sits at the intersection of two of the most dynamic transformations in industry — the reinvention of the Office of the CFO and the energy transition reshaping electric, gas, and water utilities. We partner with utilities CFOs and finance leaders to modernize the close, accounting, fixed assets, controllership, regulatory reporting, planning, and rate-case-ready data — unlocking insight, productivity, and measurable enterprise value as our clients navigate clean energy, grid modernization, and capital-intensive investment cycles.
You Are:
A trusted advisor to finance leaders who helps modernize accounting, fixed assets, and finance operations. You combine hands-on finance and ERP experience with strong consulting, communication, and delivery skills, and you bring a working understanding of the priorities that shape capital-intensive, regulated industries such as utilities. You are comfortable partnering across business, technology, client, product, testing, training, and offshore teams to align priorities, solve complex finance problems, and guide users through new ways of working. You bring practical knowledge of finance process design, fixed asset and capital accounting, and finance data, and you know how to translate CFO priorities into scalable solutions that improve controllership, decision support, and enterprise value.
The Work:
· Support finance transformation programs for utilities CFO and controller organizations, including finance process redesign, solution design, data conversion, testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live adoption.
· Lead or contribute to workstreams across core finance areas — General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets / capital accounting, Project Accounting, Intercompany, and regulatory/FERC reporting — aligning design to the client’s chart of accounts, accounting policies, and controllership requirements.
· Design and deliver Fixed Asset and capital accounting capabilities tailored to utilities — including CWIP, unitization, asset retirement obligations (AROs), depreciation studies, regulatory asset treatment, and integration with Projects and GL.
· Translate utilities CFO priorities into measurable enterprise value cases — building business cases, value architectures, and KPI baselines that link finance capabilities to outcomes such as faster close, improved forecast accuracy, rate-case readiness, and reduced cost-to-serve.
· Analyze finance process data — chart of accounts, sub-ledger mappings, master data, journals, asset registers, and reconciliations — to inform design, cleanse legacy data, and validate cutover readiness.
· Collaborate across client stakeholders, Accenture delivery teams, product teams, integration teams, testing teams, training teams, and offshore resources to deliver coordinated finance transformation outcomes.
· Support scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, user story development, acceptance criteria, demos, and defect triage for finance workstreams.
· Provide hands-on training, coaching, and enablement for utilities finance users, super users, and project team members to support long-term adoption.
· Support execution of cutover activities, deployment readiness, change enablement, and stakeholder communications for finance releases.
· Identify opportunities to improve delivery methods, solution quality, and cross-team collaboration while helping utilities CFOs realize finance transformation value.
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
What You Need:
· Minimum of 3 years Finance transformation consulting experience — including process design, controllership, close optimization, or CFO advisory work.
· Minimum of 3 years hands-on experience implementing or supporting ERP Finance solutions (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud ERP) across GL, AP, AR, or Fixed Assets.
· Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Fixed Asset / capital accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, and integration with Projects.
· Minimum of 3 years of experience working with finance process data — chart of accounts design, sub-ledger to ledger reconciliation, data conversion, or finance master data management.
· Minimum of 1 years of experience serving utilities clients (electric, gas, or water) or in a utilities finance, controllership, or regulatory function.
· Bachelor's Degree or equivalent (6 years) work experience. If an Associate's Degree, 3 years of work experience is required.
Bonus Points If:
· You have a CPA, CMA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent accounting/finance credential.
· You have familiarity with utilities-specific accounting and reporting — FERC/USoA chart of accounts, regulatory assets and liabilities, rate cases, AROs, CWIP, and unitization.
· You have ERP Finance certification (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting, Oracle Cloud ERP Financials).
· You have experience with EPM tools (SAP Group Reporting/SAC, Oracle EPM) and how they connect to finance.
· You have familiarity with embedding GenAI / agentic AI into close, controls, planning, and reporting processes.
· You have experience working in Scrum or Agile delivery environments, including user stories, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, demos, or defect resolution.
· You have experience collaborating across cross-functional business, technology, integration, testing, training, client, and offshore teams.

You are energized by the opportunity to ideate & deploy automation, AI, Agentic AI and Agentic Commerce solutions to reinvent the end-to-end Utilities Customer processes, across channels and across the front- and back-office.

Accenture’s Talent Reinvention Partner and we’re helping clients reinvent how people and organizations work—delivering leadership, talent, operating models, workforce intelligence, and change solutions to accelerate the workforce agenda in the age of AI. We develop forward‑thinking leaders who can lead effectively in an AI‑augmented workplace and navigate change with confidence. Our team is at the forefront of talent, HR, and organizational consulting, supporting clients across AI‑enabled skilling and reskilling, talent strategy, leadership development, employee experience, and change management .
You Are
An experienced change leader who understands that work has fundamentally changed. Digital, data, and Generative AI are no longer emerging capabilities – they are part of the everyday fabric of how work gets done, decisions are made, and value is created. You have led complex transformations in environments where people work alongside advanced digital tools, and you know how this shifts roles, skills, ways of working, and expectations of leadership. You bring a clear point of view on how to design and lead change when speed, scale, and continuous adaptation are the norm, and where human judgment, accountability, and trust remain essential. You use data, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to inform decisions and guide action, while applying experience and judgment to interpret what the data cannot. You are comfortable using Generative AI to accelerate analysis, design, and delivery, and you take responsibility for the quality, ethics, and impact of the outcomes. Clients and teammates look to you not just to “manage change,” but to help them operate and lead effectively in human + digital teams. You model how AI is used in the flow of work, coach others to build confidence and capability, and help teams deliver high-impact change in environments of continuous reinvention.
The Work
You will help clients reinvent how their organizations operate in an AI-enabled, data-informed world where work is digital by default, change is continuous, and people work alongside advanced tools to deliver outcomes at speed and scale.
Key responsibilities include:
· Support clients through large-scale reinvention efforts, including reimagining work, workforce models, and human-centered experiences in environments shaped by data, automation, and Generative AI
· Lead and design enterprise change programs, helping clients execute and sustain change in contexts where ways of working, roles, and skills are evolving rapidly alongside advances in technology and AI
· Partner with clients to define and enable how GenAI is used across the organization, addressing readiness, skills shifts, workforce impacts, and responsible use while reinforcing clear human accountability and governance.
· Use quantitative and qualitative data, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to assess readiness, track adoption and behavior change, and inform decisions and course correction.
· Design agile, future-ready change strategies that enable new ways of working, including operating models where humans and digital tools work together seamlessly.
· Apply human-centered design principles to co-create change solutions and personalized change journeys that can be scaled through digital and AI-enabled approaches Use Generative AI thoughtfully to accelerate change delivery, such as developing, testing, and tailoring engagement content, learning assets, and manager enablement, while remaining accountable for quality, tone, and impact
· Help clients build lasting, scalable change capabilities so they can continuously adapt as technologies, business models and ways of working evolve.
· Contribute to Accenture business development through proposals, storytelling, and building trusted client relationships.
· Be willing to travel as needed to support clients.
Here’s What You Need
· Minimum of 3 years’ Organization Change Management experience.
· Minimum of 1 year of experience as a consulting practitioner.
· Minimum of 1 year of experience working on technology-enabled or digital transformation initiatives (GenAI exposure preferred)
Bonus Points If You Have
· High Tech Industry experience preferred
· Applied experience using Generative AI (GenAI) to deliver organizational change work, including:
· Using GenAI-supported analytics and insights to understand workforce dynamics, readiness, adoption, sentiment, and behavior change
· Generating, testing, and tailoring communications and manager enablement content at speed and scale
· Supporting GenAI-enabled learning, reskilling, and knowledge sharing within organizations
· Enabling responsible GenAI adoption through clear change approaches, governance, and human accountability
· Experience leading or working in human + digital teams, where Generative AI is actively used to analyze information, generate content, and support decision-making—while ownership, judgment, and accountability remain clearly human
· Experience designing, implementing, and scaling HR and Talent processes (e.g., workforce planning, learning, performance, skills) in technology-enabled environments
· Familiarity with AI-enabled HR and workforce tools, including workforce analytics, skills platforms, automation, and future workforce design
· A demonstrated commitment to staying current on the capabilities, limitations, risks, and governance of emerging technologies—and translating them into practical, ethical, and sustainable ways of working for clients.

We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI in the abstract. We need practitioners who understand how enterprises actually operate, where the friction lives, and how to engineer smarter solutions using AI and data to fundamentally transform business processes and outcomes.
You Are:
You are a Data Strategy & Governance Consultant who executes the design and operationalization of enterprise data governance frameworks. Support the development of customer-led growth strategies by combining strong analytical thinking with commercial acumen. Experience supporting National Security, Defence, Public Sector or other highly regulated organisations. Experience working on technology-enabled transformation programmes. Strategy Consultant - Data & AI StrategyAt Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. Join our Data & AI Strategy team and be part of the future of AI consulting, where we’re not just advising clients, we’re actively disrupting traditional consulting models by embedding AI into every aspect of how we work. We’re looking for changemakers with recent, hands-on experience in AI development, people who not only understand the technology but can connect it to the bigger picture. You’ll help our clients build, scale, and embed AI capabilities across their organisations, driving transformation from strategy through to execution.  Your RoleThis role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex problems. From Agentic AI in risk governance, to AI sovereignty in enterprise architecture, to enabling the AI-empowered workforce of tomorrow, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of what’s next. We REDEFINE strategy – You will work with clients to define their ambition for AI, identify high-impact use cases and design prioritisation frameworks that guide investment to ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business goals and built for scale.We ENABLE business transformation with AI – You will help clients disrupt their business model to embed AI and automation into core business processes to unlock new capabilities, drive efficiency, and deliver measurable impact.We BUILD scalable AI capability - You will help organisations develop and scale AI across functions, embedding the right skills, tools, governance and culture to enable sustainable adoption. From operating models to talent strategy, we ensure AI becomes a core part of how the business operates.We DRIVE responsible AI adoption - You will help organisations design and implement robust frameworks to safely and responsibly deploy, monitor and assure AI. We ensure AI is used transparently, securely, and inline with core business values.We SUPERCHARGE delivery - We leverage the power of AI to accelerate delivery and drive innovation for our clients and our business. As part of this role you will be encouraged to experiment with new AI and automation technologies to build proof of concepts, augment research and automate tasks.   As part of your role alongside client work you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: Business Development - Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.Internal contribution - Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.Learning & development - Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.Your ProfileAs a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team you’ll be part of the future of AI consulting. We look for individuals who align with our core values, are creative problem solvers, and have a genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies. You’ll be passionate about helping organisations unlock the potential of AI not just through technical delivery, but by driving strategic change.Below some of the key skills and experiences we look for in candidates. We don't expect you to hit every point- we want to build a team which has diverse backgrounds, perspectives and strengths. Key skills: Growth mindset and curiosity - You’re always learning, experimenting with new technologies, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.Strategic thinking - You have strong problem solving and analytical skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and develop clear, actionable recommendations.Excellent communication and collaboration skills - You’re confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels, translating complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives.Strong understanding of data and AI technologies - Whether through hands-on development or strategic project exposure, you can confidently engage with AI concepts and tools.Experience in AI strategy and delivery - You’ve contributed to or led projects from discovery and defining the strategy, through to deployment either in a technical or strategic role.AI capability development and enablement - You’ve supported organisations in building their AI capabilities whether through designing learning pathways, shaping operating models, running readiness assessments, or simply helping teams understand how to get started with AI.Understanding of AI ethics and assurance - You’re aware of the risks and responsibilities of AI, and can contribute to designing frameworks for safe, transparent, and accountable deployment.Understanding and prefereably  demonstrable experince of Public Sector and Policy English - Fluent written and verbal          Technology & delivery experience:Understanding of data and AI technologies, in particular GenAI & Agentic Systems - Whether through hands-on development or strategic exposure, you can confidently engage with AI concepts and tools and understand how to apply these technologies to solve real business challenges.Workshop design and facilitation - You’ve designed and led engaging workshops, both virtually and in person.Presentation and storytelling - You’re comfortable presenting insights, recommendations, and prototypes to clients and internal teams.High-quality output delivery - You take pride in producing impactful deliverables, from proof of concepts and interactive designs to business cases and strategy documents.MSc in Public policyConsulting experience        We are recruiting for two levels of seniority and you will be assessed during our interview process:Consultants: You’ll have a strong foundation in data and AI, and are able to showcase your entrepreneurship and consulting skillsSenior Consultants: You’ll bring experience delivering AI strategy and transformation projects and consulting skillsNeed to knowAt Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.CSRWe’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.Consultant LevelAs this is a Consultant-level position, we are seeking individuals who can deliver defined pieces of work, apply their expertise to solve problems, conduct analysis, and support the delivery of client outcomes. Consultants are typically expected to work with guidance from more senior team members while continuing to build both the breadth and depth of their experience across projects and engagements. About CapgeminiCapgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. Je werkt aan vraagstukken op het snijvlak van customer experience, service design, marketingtechnologie, AI en digitale transformatie.In deze rol werk je aan:Het ontwikkelen van klantgerichte strategieën en omnichannel oplossingen voor organisaties in onder meer retail, financiële dienstverlening en de publieke sector.Het analyseren van klantbehoeften met behulp van marktonderzoek, klantonderzoek, data-analyse en co-creatie workshops om verbeterkansen te identificeren.Het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe klantreizen, service blueprints, AI-gedreven customer experience strategieën, marketingtechnologie-oplossingen en digitale proposities voor toonaangevende organisaties. Voorbeelden zijn het lanceren van nieuwe verkoopkanalen, het implementeren van marketingtechnologieën en het ontwerpen van end-to-end klantbelevingen voor banken, verzekeraars en publieke instellingen.Let op: voor deze functie is beheersing van de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau vereist. Win hearts. Move markets. Create the future.Ready to make your mark?Jouw profielJe hebt:Een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding in bijvoorbeeld Strategic product design, Business, Innovation, Transformation, Marketing, Design, Data of AI.Minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring en affiniteit met strategieontwikkeling rondom digitale klantbeleving en customer experience.Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden waarmee je complexe informatie vertaalt naar begrijpelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen.Ervaring of affiniteit met design thinking, klantonderzoek, marketingactivatie, projectmanagement, marketingtechnologie (bij voorkeur Adobe en Salesforce) en AI-gerelateerde toepassingen.Je maakt bewust gebruik van AI-tools, beoordeelt output kritisch en staat open voor het continu ontwikkelen van nieuwe kennis en vaardigheden binnen een snel veranderende technologische omgeving.Deze criteria geven een indicatie van het profiel dat we zoeken. Voldoe je niet aan alle criteria maar denk je wel dat dit de juiste functie voor jou is, dan nodigen we je van harte uit om toch te solliciteren of contact op te nemen.Wat bieden wij jou?Direct een vast contract vanaf dag één met een startsalaris van €2.950 bruto per maand op basis van een 40-urige werkweek.Een mobiliteitsvergoeding van €800 bruto per maand met de keuze voor een leaseauto, NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding.26 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra verlofdagen bij te kopen.Uitgebreide Learning & Development mogelijkheden via de Capgemini Academy, certificeringen, digitale leerplatforms en de nieuwste AI-trainingen en tools.Deelname aan The Institute, een intensief opleidingsprogramma van twee maanden waarin je consultancyvaardigheden ontwikkelt door middel van praktijkopdrachten, coaching en feedback.Persoonlijke begeleiding, coaching en ondersteuning voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke groei.Flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en een connectiviteits- en thuiswerkvergoeding die jouw work-life balance ondersteunen.Een volledig door de werkgever betaald pensioen, met de mogelijkheid om zelf extra bij te dragen.Een laptop en simkaart die je zowel zakelijk als privé mag gebruiken.De mogelijkheid om samen te werken met een wereldwijd netwerk van experts en op termijn internationale ervaring op te doen. Interesse? Solliciteer direct online met je CV & motivatiebrief waarin je ons laat zien welke relevante ervaring/skills jij meebrengt op het gebied van CX/Marketing/Tech/Design en waarom jij bij frog wilt werken! We kijken uit naar je reactie!Jouw werkomgevingJe maakt onderdeel uit van een team van ruim 40 klantgerichte strategen in de Utrechtse studio van frog. Binnen het team werk je samen met designers, creatieven, marketeers, consultants en technologie-experts die organisaties helpen hun klantbeleving, proposities en dienstverlening te transformeren. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot een wereldwijd netwerk van meer dan 2.000 frogs en de brede expertise van Capgemini Invent.Bij Capgemini Invent geloven we dat verschil verandering mogelijk maakt. Als transformatieconsultants combineren we strategie, creativiteit, data en technologie om complexe uitdagingen van vandaag én morgen op te lossen. Samen met onze klanten ontwikkelen we innovatieve oplossingen die worden onderbouwd door wetenschap, versterkt door AI en tot leven gebracht door design. jd_text:
Senior Management Consultant, Digital Engineering & R&D
 Vi på Capgemini Invent tror på att olikheter driver förändring. Som transformationskonsulter förenar vi strategiska, kreativa och vetenskapliga kompetenser och samarbetar nära våra kunder för att leverera lösningar i framkant. Bli en del av oss och driv transformation anpassad efter våra kunders utmaningar. Med vetenskap och data som grund, kreativitet och design som drivkraft – och teknik skapad med syfte som möjliggörare. Din rollSom en del av vårt Intelligent Industry Digital Engineering & R&D‑team stöttar du ledande industriföretag i att modernisera hur de utvecklar produkter, tjänster och system. Du arbetar nära R&D- och engineering‑organisationer för att koppla samman affär, teknik och operativa behov, från strategi till genomförande. Du visar hur digitalisering, data och AI kan stärka produktutveckling, driva snabbare innovation och skapa effektivare engineering‑flöden.Typiska uppdrag kan inkludera att:Driva transformationer inom Digital Engineering & R&D: Utveckla strategier, roadmaps och operating models för mer digital, modellbaserad, datadriven och AI‑stärkt produktutveckling.Leda business adoption & change: Agera länk mellan R&D, engineering och IT genom att leda workshops, samla in krav, koordinera stakeholders och säkerställa att nya arbetssätt implementeras med hög adoption.Utveckla framtida engineering capabilities: Stärka kunders förmågor inom systems engineering, model‑based development, krav- och informationshantering samt digitala flöden mellan Sales-Engineering–Manufacturing–Service.Förbättra operativ förmåga genom insikter: Analysera R&D‑ och engineering‑processer, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och ta fram rekommendationer som ökar effektivitet och kvalitet samt skapar mätbara affärsvärden. Din profil Du är en drivande och analytisk person som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan affär, teknik och produktutveckling. Du är van att strukturera komplexa frågeställningar, skapa samsyn mellan olika intressenter och omsätta strategi till konkreta resultat. Du är nyfiken på hur digitalisering, data och AI kan stärka R&D‑organisationer och vill vara med och driva transformation från strategi till implementering.Vi söker i första hand Senior Consultants till vårt team, men för rätt profil är vi även öppna för rekrytering på Manager-nivå. Du har:2-4 års erfarenhet från management consulting eller liknande transformationsroller inom industri, R&D eller engineeringGoda analytiska färdigheter och förmåga att strukturera komplexa frågeställningarErfarenhet eller stort intresse för Digital Engineering, såsom systems engineering, modellbaserade arbetssätt, produktutveckling eller R&D‑processerFörståelse för hur digitalisering, data och AI kan skapa värde i produktutveckling och engineeringTrygghet i att facilitera workshops och leda stakeholders, samt driva change & adoption i tvärfunktionella teamMasterexamen inom teknik, industriell ekonomi, produktutveckling eller motsvarandeMycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska samt svenskt arbetstillståndDet här kommer du uppskatta hos ossPå Capgemini Invent blir du en del av ett globalt team som formar framtiden för Digital Engineering & R&D. Vi erbjuder:Mening & påverkan: Du driver transformation hos ledande företag och hjälper dem definiera sin strategiska riktning samt etablera struktur och planer som förverkligar morgondagens banbrytande tjänster och lösningar.Innovation i stor skala: Du arbetar med den allra senaste tekniken och de mest avancerade strategierna för att lösa komplexa branschutmaningar.Kollegor i absoluta toppskiktet: Du arbetar tillsammans med några av marknadens främsta konsulter, ingenjörer och transformationsledare inom Digital Engineering, AI och Industry.En samarbetsorienterad kultur: Du blir en del av ett inkluderande team som värdesätter kreativitet, nyfikenhet och modiga idéer. Bra att vetaPlacering: För denna roll utgår du från vårt centralt belägna Stockholms- eller Göteborgsskontor och är redo att resa till kund vid behov. Senioritet och titel fastställs baserat på din bakgrund och erfarenhet. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomförs identitetskontroll via ID‑handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma vid behov.Vi söker framför allt Senior Consultants till teamet. Har du mer omfattande erfarenhet och en stark profil inom området kan vi även erbjuda möjligheter på Manager-nivå. Om Capgemini Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
S trategy Insights & Planning Consultant
ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.
Strategy Insights & Planning Consultant - R&D
Strategy Insights & Planning Consultants deliver high-quality solutions for our clients. Consultants possess unstructured problem-solving skills as well as strong analytic, synthesis and communication skills. Consultants may work on multiple projects simultaneously. As Consultants advance in their career, they specialize in a particular industry, practice area and/or client relationship.
What You’ll Do:
· Work with project leadership to define project scope and develop approach.
· Research and Development experience desired.
· Strong strategy experience required.
· Consulting experience from Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG or other top similar firms.
· Lead project task execution by ensuring progress, organizing project data and coordinating team meetings.
· Conduct issue analysis and develop hypotheses on the key client issues.
· Design and execute qualitative and/or quantitative analyses to test and analyze hypotheses.
· Synthesize findings, develop recommendations, and communicate results to clients and internal teams.
· Provide thought leadership and innovation within projects and practice areas.
· Participate in business development.
· Contribute to internal firm activities.
· Coach and mentor junior team members.
What You’ll Bring:
· MBA with bachelor's (and often graduate) degrees with a strong academic record in business, economics, marketing, psychology, physical or life sciences, engineering, applied math, statistics, or related fields. Alternately, candidates may possess a PhD in marketing, economics, decision sciences or related field with a business application. In lieu of an MBA or PhD, 5-8 years of relevant work experience may substitute.
· Up to 3 years of post-MBA relevant work experience, and 3-5 years of pre-MBA work experience.
· High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative.
· Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, leading and managing teams.
· Effective oral and written communication skills that enable personal impact with senior-level decision makers.
· Strong attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset.
· Analytic problem-solving skills, with a creative and innovative outlook;
· Client service orientation
· Fluency in English
· Client-first mentality
· Intense work ethic
· Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach How you’ll grow:
· Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
· Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
· Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions
Perks & Benefits:
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States , visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS .
Hybrid working model:
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
Travel:
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant
Shape how life-changing therapies reach patients — by helping pharmaceutical companies navigate the payer and market access landscape with sharper intelligence.
ZS's Value & Access practice partners with leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies to solve their most pressing market access and reimbursement challenges. Our work spans payer strategy, pricing architecture, access program design, and reimbursement research grounded in direct, rigorous primary research with the payers, PBMs, and providers who make coverage and formulary decisions every day.
As an Associate Consultant , you'll be in the room conducting in-depth interviews with managed care decision-makers, synthesizing findings into access strategies, and helping clients understand the coverage and reimbursement landscape before and after launch.
What you’ll do
· Translate complex payer and provider intelligence into access landscape assessments, coverage barrier analyses, and reimbursement risk frameworks that guide pre-launch and in-market strategy
· Lead pricing and contracting strategy projects, synthesizing WAC/net pricing benchmarks, formulary positioning data, and competitive access dynamics into actionable recommendations
· Oversee quantitative analyses using claims data, formulary databases, and pricing benchmarks, ensuring analytical rigor and strategic coherence across workstreams.
· Structure and deliver executive-level presentations to senior client stakeholders, including VP and C-suite market access and commercial leaders
· Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Associates and Associate Consultants — setting the standard for research quality, client presence, and professional growth
· Contribute to ZS's Value & Access thought leadership, proposal development, and capability building as a recognized expert in the payer and reimbursement space
· Gain immediate familiarity with client’s internal processes.
· Develop expertise within a client analytics area.
· Be available for clients during regular working hours.
What you’ll bring
· MBA with a bachelor's (and often graduate) degree in a quantitative, analytical discipline, such as Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Management Science, Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, or Engineering.
· 3+ years of market access, payer strategy, or reimbursement consulting experience in or serving the pharmaceutical industry with a track record of leading engagements, not just contributing to them
· Demonstrated expertise conducting qualitative primary research with U.S. payers, PBMs, and providers; including experience designing research programs and moderating senior-level interviews independently
· Comprehensive fluency in the U.S. payer landscape: managed care organizations, Medicare Part B and D, Medicaid, formulary management, prior authorization, step therapy, and specialty pharmacy channels
· Command of pharmaceutical pricing strategy and contracting — WAC, net pricing, rebate structures, value-based agreements, and GPO/IDN dynamics
· Strong analytical foundation — able to oversee and pressure-test claims data analyses, formulary database modeling, and pricing benchmarking work
· Proven ability to lead client relationships with autonomy. You manage expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and consistently earn trust with senior stakeholders
· Experience leading and developing junior consultants, with a genuine investment in their growth
· Fluency in English
· Client-first mentality
· Intense work ethic
· Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

Description
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries . We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
Corporate Transactions Group (\CTG\)
CTG, a subsidiary of A&M, brings a structured and disciplined approach to create and capture value throughout the M&A deal cycle. We provide corporate clients with deep leadership and expertise to bring an end-to-end solution for corporate clients as they enter into potential buys-side acquisitions, sell-side divestitures and carve-outs, and strategic partnerships.
Our professionals help businesses develop and execute their strategies to create value for the organization and its shareholders leveraging A&M’s functional expertise and industry experience. We provide a range of services to our clients, including commercial due diligence, market entry assessment, financial and operational due diligence, tax diligence and structuring assistance, business modeling and synergy assessment, integration & separation planning, and support executing the plan and delivering enterprise value for our client’s shareholders.
Our CTG practice is growing rapidly which means there is a unique opportunity to be creative and entrepreneurial to help shape the foundation of our future. We are currently seeking dynamic and experienced professionals to join our team, focusing on the operational and execution aspects of the M&A life cycle (from early-stage diligence through to post-close implementation). In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. The position offers significant opportunities for career development and advancement in a fast-growing practice that is helping lead many market shaping deals.
As a Senior Associate, you will have the opportunity to work with our highly motivated and effective team of professionals on a variety of interesting projects across different industries including but not limited to manufacturing, distribution, consumer, retail, restaurants, business and industrial services, healthcare, software & technology, aerospace and defense, and energy. You will provide our corporate and private equity clients with an integrated due diligence approach that goes beyond traditional quality of earning analyses and focus on key value drivers related to buy-side and sell-side transactions. Our integrated due diligence approach combines our deep operational, functional and industry expertise with Big Four quality financial accounting and tax services to drive value throughout the investment lifecycle.
Responsibilities will include:
Assist with core financial due diligence, helping to identify key risks and potential deal breakers, assess the strengths and weaknesses of the business against industry benchmarks, and aid in the evaluation of the potential transaction in the context of their clients’ investment strategy.
• Analyze detailed financial statement information including income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and key operational data. Synthesize and convert the data into meaningful information that is used to drive discussions with target management and drive observations and conclusions.
• Assess the quality of the target company’s reported earnings, net assets and cash flows.
• After an investigative analysis, assist in the construction of deal-oriented reports and presentations for clients that highlight the key financial, commercial and other findings facing investments and the drivers behind maintainable profits and cash flows. Aid the team in further articulating how such findings should be incorporated into the client’s valuation and sale, purchase agreement and provide other negotiating points
• Participate in meetings and conference calls with target company management and with client personnel and serve as a secondary point of contact for client personnel with respect to day-to-day execution matters.
• Be actively involved in building and maintaining client relationships and other business development opportunities.
• Counsel and mentor CTG associates and analysts.
• Engage in training initiatives (developing and teaching appropriate courses) to develop CTG associates and analysts.
• Research technical accounting subjects relevant to CTG that are
necessary to deliver exceptional client services (relative to financial due diligence)
• Research technical accounting subjects relevant to CTG that are necessary to deliver exceptional client services (relative to financial due diligence).
• Coordinate with all other A&M service groups and functional areas during an engagement as appropriate.
• Delegate work to associates and analysts throughout engagement.
• Review and develop associates and analysts based on work performed.
Qualifications:
• A minimum of 3 years of financial accounting due diligence experience or equivalent at a top accounting firm.
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting and/or related major.
• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or the equivalent of a CPA.
• Working knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting and purchase accounting.
• High proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and database skills.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) including the ability to articulate to senior members of target management, client representatives and colleagues.
• Proficient in basic project management skills.
• Flexibility to work as both a team member in a collaborative setting and as an individual contributor.
• Ability to travel for projects and A&M specific needs as necessary.
• Ability to thrive and be effective in a fast-paced setting.
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success , which is why w e prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning , rewards your contributions , and fosters a culture of meritocracy . With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being , providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high - performing and passionate professionals.
The base salary is $130,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.
Benefits Summary
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a n annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click  here  for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs

About Alvarez & Marsal

Corporate Transactions Group (\CTG\)
CTG, a subsidiary of A&M, brings a structured and disciplined approach to create and capture value throughout the M&A deal cycle. We provide corporate clients with deep leadership and expertise to bring an end-to-end solution for corporate clients as they enter into potential buys-side acquisitions, sell-side divestitures and carve-outs, and strategic partnerships.
Our professionals help businesses develop and execute their strategies to create value for the organization and its shareholders leveraging A&M’s functional expertise and industry experience. We provide a range of services to our clients, including commercial due diligence, market entry assessment, financial and operational due diligence, tax diligence and structuring assistance, business modeling and synergy assessment, integration & separation planning, and support executing the plan and delivering enterprise value for our client’s shareholders.
Our CTG practice is growing rapidly which means there is a unique opportunity to be creative and entrepreneurial to help shape the foundation of our future. We are currently seeking dynamic and experienced professionals to join our team, focusing on the operational and execution aspects of the M&A life cycle (from early-stage diligence through to post-close implementation). In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. The position offers significant opportunities for career development and advancement in a fast-growing practice that is helping lead many market shaping deals.
As a Senior Associate, you will have the opportunity to work with our highly motivated and effective team of professionals on a variety of interesting projects across different industries including but not limited to manufacturing, distribution, consumer, retail, restaurants, business and industrial services, healthcare, software & technology, aerospace and defense, and energy. You will provide our corporate and private equity clients with an integrated due diligence approach that goes beyond traditional quality of earning analyses and focus on key value drivers related to buy-side and sell-side transactions. Our integrated due diligence approach combines our deep operational, functional and industry expertise with Big Four quality financial accounting and tax services to drive value throughout the investment lifecycle.
Responsibilities will include:
Assist with core financial due diligence, helping to identify key risks and potential deal breakers, assess the strengths and weaknesses of the business against industry benchmarks, and aid in the evaluation of the potential transaction in the context of their clients’ investment strategy.
• Analyze detailed financial statement information including income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and key operational data. Synthesize and convert the data into meaningful information that is used to drive discussions with target management and drive observations and conclusions.
• Assess the quality of the target company’s reported earnings, net assets and cash flows.
• After an investigative analysis, assist in the construction of deal-oriented reports and presentations for clients that highlight the key financial, commercial and other findings facing investments and the drivers behind maintainable profits and cash flows. Aid the team in further articulating how such findings should be incorporated into the client’s valuation and sale, purchase agreement and provide other negotiating points
• Participate in meetings and conference calls with target company management and with client personnel and serve as a secondary point of contact for client personnel with respect to day-to-day execution matters.
• Be actively involved in building and maintaining client relationships and other business development opportunities.
• Counsel and mentor CTG associates and analysts.
• Engage in training initiatives (developing and teaching appropriate courses) to develop CTG associates and analysts.
• Research technical accounting subjects relevant to CTG that are
necessary to deliver exceptional client services (relative to financial due diligence)
• Research technical accounting subjects relevant to CTG that are necessary to deliver exceptional client services (relative to financial due diligence).
• Coordinate with all other A&M service groups and functional areas during an engagement as appropriate.
• Delegate work to associates and analysts throughout engagement.
• Review and develop associates and analysts based on work performed.
Qualifications:
• A minimum of 3 years of financial accounting due diligence experience or equivalent at a top accounting firm.
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting and/or related major.
• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or the equivalent of a CPA.
• Working knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting and purchase accounting.
• High proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and database skills.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) including the ability to articulate to senior members of target management, client representatives and colleagues.
• Proficient in basic project management skills.
• Flexibility to work as both a team member in a collaborative setting and as an individual contributor.
• Ability to travel for projects and A&M specific needs as necessary.
• Ability to thrive and be effective in a fast-paced setting.
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success , which is why w e prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning , rewards your contributions , and fosters a culture of meritocracy . With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being , providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high - performing and passionate professionals.
The base salary is $130,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.
Benefits Summary
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a n annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click  here  for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs

We’re BDO. An accountancy and business advisory firm, providing the advice and solutions entrepreneurial organisations need to navigate today’s changing world.

We’ll broaden your horizons
Our Advisory team provide a wide variety of services that deliver value-led advice and outcomes. They have an in-depth knowledge of business, industry sectors and markets and understand the constantly changing risks and opportunities at the heart of our clients’ affairs. The team work across strategy, operations and improvement as well as at a transactional and defined project level. From technology to risk advisory, they’re experts in following through on top-level instructions and resolving the finer details – all in one straight-forward package. When you join them, you’ll work on some of the world's most exciting financial operations and business deals, building your experience and expertise alongside the brightest minds in the industry.

Leading organisations trust us because of the quality of our advice. That quality grows from a thorough understanding of their business, and that understanding comes from working closely with them and building long-lasting relationships.
You’ll be someone who is both comfortable working pro-actively and managing your own tasks, as well as confident collaborating with others and communicating regularly with senior managers, directors, and BDO’s partners to help businesses effectively. You’ll be encouraged to identify and draw attention to opportunities for enhancing our delivery and providing additional services to organisations we work with. .
As a Senior Analyst or Analyst you'll join our Tech, Risk & Governance team (TRG) part of our Digital practice withing Consulting. This is a rapidly growing business area. You'll help clients understand and manage the risks arising from technology, transformation and digital change. The client base is diverse and you'll support technology risk assessments, IT internal audits, controls assurance and advisory engagements that strengthen governance, resilience and confidence in our clients most critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a high performing digital team and develop your career.
You'll be someone with:
· Experience in technology risk, IT internal audit, IT assurance, risk and controls, or a closely related discipline, gained in professional services, financial services or another regulated organisation.
· Experience in one or more relevant areas: IT general controls and SOX/ICFR; cloud risk; DevOps and SDLC controls; ERP risk and controls; operational resilience; third-party technology risk; data or AI governance; end-user computing; programme assurance
· Financial services experience is desirable such as banks. insurers, asset managers, payments or capital markets organisations and frameworks such as FCA and PRA requirements, operational resilience and outsourcing or third-party risk expectations.
· A practical understanding of technology risks and controls, with the ability to analyse evidence, identify control weaknesses and communicate their business impact clearly.
· Relevant qualifications or progress towards them, such as CISA, ACA, ACCA, CIA, CRISC, CISSP or cloud certifications, would be advantageous but are not essential.
You’ll also be able to be yourself; we’ll recognise and value you for who you are and celebrate and reward your contributions to the business. We’re committed to agile working, and we offer everyone the opportunity to work in ways that suit them, their teams, and the task in hand.
At BDO, we’ll help you achieve your personal goals and career ambitions, and we have programmes, resources, and frameworks that provide clarity and structure around career development.
We’re in it together
Mutual support and respect is one of BDO’s core values and we’re proud of our distinctive, people-centred culture. From informal success conversations to formal mentoring and coaching, we’ll support you at every stage in your career, whatever your personal and professional needs.
Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another. At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.
We know that collaboration is the key to creating value for the companies we work with and satisfying experiences for our colleagues, so we’ve invested in state-of-the-art collaboration spaces in our offices. BDO’s people represent a wealth of knowledge and expertise, and we’ll encourage you to build your network, work alongside others, and share your skills and experiences. With a range of multidisciplinary events and dedicated resources, you’ll never stop learning at BDO.
We’re looking forward to the future
At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy.
Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in you. Across the UK thousands of unique minds continue to come together to help companies we work with to achieve their ambitions
We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. We shape the future together with openness and clarity, because we believe in empowering people to think creatively about how we can do things better.

jd_text:
Strategic Risk Consulting (SRC) is a part of the wider Risk & Analytics division within Corporate Risk and Broking, which provides an integrated approach to risk management in the current complex global business environment. SRC is a diverse team, with a global footprint and consists of actuaries, engineers, natural catastrophe modelers and enterprise risk management specialists. SRC helps companies identify, quantify, and prioritize their major risks, and connect risk management decisions to corporate financial performance.
We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Risk Consultant within our SRC practice. You will be at the forefront of innovation and technology and get involved in a wide range of fascinating projects.
You will lead the delivery of data-driven insightful analyses to some of the world’s largest and complex organizations. Your modelling skills will be used to help clients quantify their risk and develop risk transfer strategies that exploit arbitrage opportunities among mitigation, transfer, and retention levers and align risk decisions with financial strategy enhancing organizational resilience and maximizing performance.
If you enjoy being intellectually stimulated, working with people from different industries and backgrounds, and deploying state-of-the-art tools and technology, we want to meet with you.
The Role
· Oversee and perform modeling analysis for clients’ risks by applying standard actuarial techniques as well as WTW proprietary tools
· Ensure quality of work by participating in our peer reviewing process
· Maintain a comprehensive audit trail for all analytical work
· Present analytical results and recommendations to clients in a timely and professional manner
· Ability to direct work for more junior colleagues and provide feedback and coaching
· Develop a trusted advisor relationship with internal WTW client relationship managers through effective communication and quality execution of projects
· Support the development of new business opportunities and enhancing existing relationships
· Participate in Research & Development of new initiatives as required
The Requirements
· 5+ years of risk/insurance analytic experience, actuarial experience desirable
· Excellent communication and presentation skills
· Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to different audiences
· Client facing experience preferred
· Good understanding of how insurance coverages operate
· Work well in a team environment
· Project management skills preferred
· Well-organized, intellectual curiosity and positive attitude
· Experience using AI models for project research
· Proficiency in Microsoft Office, programming skills (R) desirable
Above all, you will be hungry to continue to grow your project management skills and to develop your business development and team management capabilities. You will also have the innovation and problem-solving abilities that are regularly required to design bespoke risk consulting solutions and models for our clients.
Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.
Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).
Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $130,000.00-$175,000.00 USD annually. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits
WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):
· Health and Welfare: Mental health/emotional wellbeing (including Employee Assistance Program), medical (including prescription drug coverage and fertility benefits), dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Accounts, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, company-paid life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D, group accident, group critical illness, group legal, identity theft protection, wellbeing program, adoption assistance, surrogacy assistance, auto/home insurance, pet insurance, and other work/life resources.
· Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles)
· Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Breakthroughs in pharma are helping people live healthier lives, while medical devices enable patients to proactively maintain health – this is undoubtedly a transformative time for health care companies. You will have an immediate impact by partnering with our clients, across all levels, to deliver product planning, pricing, reimbursement, product commercialization, and regulatory and compliance solutions.
As a Senior Consultant, you are responsible for data management, technical delivery, and coaching data engineers to execute client work. In this role you will develop and improve predictive models for outcomes, efficacy proxies, and forecasting using statistical and machine learning methods in addition to conducting advanced analytics using big datasets, including claims, affiliations, payer, sales, and other sources. · Strong fluency coding in SQL, Python (or other equivalent scripting language), cloud data platforms, and knowledge of life sciences data (e.g., claims, EHR, sales data, formulary, and coverage data)

Guidehouse's Public Sector Health team is seeking a Senior Consultant to support federal clients oversight, monitoring, and program integrity activities for block grant programs. This role supports targeted oversight and monitoring activities designed to help identify, assess, and address program integrity risks outside routine monitoring cycles. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills with experience working with federal grants programs, monitoring and oversight processes, and program integrity-related activities. Successful clients will work collaboratively with clients and project teams to with federal staff, grant recipients, and project teams to assess risks, conduct monitoring activities, develop actionable recommendations, and support program accountability and continuous improvement.

· Support federal clients in conducting targeted oversight and monitoring activities for federal grants programs.
· Review significant audit findings, recipient responses, corrective-action plans, internal control documentation, and supporting records to assess programmatic and operational risks.

· Evaluate the status and effectiveness of corrective actions and support follow-up activities to address unresolved monitoring findings.

At Guidehouse, grants management is not a back-office compliance function—it’s where public dollars turn into real outcomes. Our team works at the center of some of the largest, most complex federal and state funding programs in the country, partnering directly with government leaders to design, launch, and sustain programs that matter—from healthcare access and community recovery to energy transition and infrastructure resilience.
You’ll join a team that combines deep technical credibility with strategic influence. We don’t just help clients comply with 2 CFR 200—we shape how programs are structured, governed, and delivered so they withstand scrutiny, adapt to shifting federal priorities, and produce measurable impact. Our consultants are trusted advisors, often embedded alongside agency leadership, helping translate policy into executable, audit defensible operations.
Guidehouse invests in how grants work tomorrow, not just how they worked yesterday. That includes modernizing grants operations with data, analytics, and AI enabled tools—while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and human judgment that public funding demands. You’ll have opportunities to innovate responsibly, build new solutions, and influence firmwide approaches to grants modernization.
Equally important, you’ll be part of a collaborative, mission driven culture. We value clarity, quality, and professionalism—and we support career paths that reward both subject matter depth and leadership. Whether you want to specialize deeply, lead large programs, or grow into broader advisory roles, Guidehouse provides the platform and trust to do meaningful work at scale.
If you’re looking for a place where your grants expertise is respected, your ideas shape outcomes, and your work has visible public value, this is that team.
