jd_text:
ICF is a leading provider of science-based climate, environmental and energy advisory services to private and public sector clients across the globe. We help our clients progress on their transformation journey, from the understanding of this rapidly evolving landscape to the design and implementation of impactful strategies and actions plans all the way to their evaluation.
To support the continued growth of our Sustainable Finance, Climate and Biodiversity Policy practice, we are looking for experienced Senior Consultants to join our team in Brussels, Spain or London. The successful candidate will join a dynamic team and support our diverse policy work. You will get the opportunity to work on flagship projects such as the Innovation Fund, studies related to climate diplomacy, and the transformation of our society towards a net-zero, nature positive and socially just model. Your work will benefit clients such as the European Commission, national governments, and international and national development finance institutions.
Our team has built a reputation for the successful delivery of large, complex projects, developing innovative solutions that drive positive change for their clients and support the overall sustainable transition in the EU and beyond.
Some of our flagship projects include:
· Providing continuous expertise since 2019 to support the successful implementation of the EU Emissions Trading System’s Innovation Fund
· Supporting the design of decarbonisation strategies and transition pathways at EU and national level
· Supporting the development of a long-term research and innovation agenda towards 2050 climate neutrality (see report here)
· Designing Sustainable Finance Action Plans for different EU Member States (e.g. Poland, Italy) to redirect public and private capitals towards the low carbon transition · Delivering the European Business and Biodiversity Platform since 2013 for the European Commission
· Evaluating the impact of green bonds on supporting climate mitigation investments for the European Investment Bank and European Bank for Reconstruction & Development
· Supporting National Promotional Banks in Poland and Spain with their sustainable finance strategies
Responsibilities:
You will work as part of a multi-national, multi-disciplinary and collaborative team of climate and environmental experts, economists, engineers, financial experts, and communication specialists to:
· · Support the delivery of projects for public and private clients
· Support the management of projects and take the lead in the deployment of discrete tasks and activities
· Provide robust and sound qualitative and quantitative analysis and support the translation of complex data into meaningful and impactful recommendations
· Engage with stakeholders through both quantitative and qualitative surveys
· Support ICF’s thought leadership in climate policy, identifying emerging trends and opportunities and help to translate these into new service offers that will benefit clients

· Fluency in spoken English and excellent English writing skills
· Master’s degree in climate or environmental sciences, environmental economics, environmental engineering, political sciences, or a related discipline
· Professional working experience of at least 5 years in the field of climate policy at EU level, with an excellent understanding of the latest policy developments (e.g. Net Zero Industry Act; Climate Law; EU ETS; etc.).
· Demonstrable experience of public policy project delivery and management, and ideally with experience of conducting policy and programme evaluations
· Strong qualitative and quantitative analysis capability, including advanced knowledge of Excel and equivalent tools
· Proven communication skills and track record in the field of stakeholder engagement, especially within public authorities and the business and finance community
· Ability to work independently as well as within multi-cultural, multi-disciplinary consulting teams spread across several countries and time zones

· Fluency in a second EU language
· Entrepreneurial mindset eager to innovate and develop new solutions to address the climate and environmental crises.

Job Description
We are looking for Senior Consultants to join the water team in our growing UK environmental policy team. The role will sit in ICF’s European Policy, Research, Evaluation and Strategy unit.
ICF provides independent policy research, evaluation and analytical support to the Defra group and other UK public sector clients. We provide robust evidence and strategic support to policy-makers and regulators, using the latest research and evaluation methodologies, advanced data science and behavioural insights. We work across the full spectrum of UK environmental and related policies, from nature restoration to food production, climate adaptation to resource management.
We have a growing portfolio of work focused on diverse aspects of water policy. We are working on evaluations of flood risk management programmes, studies on new governance models for water resource management, mechanisms for mobilisation of finance for nature recovery, and appraisal of water-focused innovation programmes.
This demand for ICF support creates exciting opportunities for experienced consultants that have expertise in the evaluation of programmes, development of governance models and appraisal of investments in the water and flood resilience sector to work on projects that contribute directly to the development and improvement of policies and programmes.
When you join ICF we will provide you with the opportunity to develop your knowledge and skills further through excellent training and development support, structured career guidance systems, our mentoring programme, communities of practice and line management arrangements.
Successful candidates will have the following skills and experience:
· Demonstrable interest and experience in environmental policy, especially in relation to water policy in the UK (e.g. water resources, floods, water quality)
· Strong qualitative, quantitative and analytical skills
· Skills in evaluation, economic analysis and appraisal, impact assessment, data science, and/or environmental economics
· Good understanding of UK policy-making process (experience of working on assignments for the UK Government would be an advantage)
· Degree, Master’s degree or PhD in relevant discipline
· Relevant professional experience of at least 5 years
· Experience managing projects, including budgets and research teams
· Business development experience, including contributing to proposals / grant applications
· Exceptional ability to write and communicate in English
· Strong organisational and collaborative working skills
· Highly-developed interpersonal skills and self-motivation
Prior experience in a consulting environment would be an advantage but we also welcome applicants with backgrounds in academia, government and non-governmental employment.
Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship (UK)
While we welcome applications from candidates internationally, this role is located in the United Kingdom , and successful candidates must:
· Have the legal right to work in the UK ( or be eligible for sponsorship where applicable on a case-by-case basis); and
· Be physically located in the UK on Day 1 of employment (or shortly before your start date). Please ensure you can meet the right-to-work and location requirements or would qualify for sponsorship where applicable.

Sustainable Aviation Analytics Associate
Are you looking for an opportunity to use data and analytical tools to help make aviation more sustainable? We are seeking a new colleague who can apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to complex sustainability challenges in an aviation context.
Decarbonising aviation has never been more important. Our work spans the design, evaluation and implementation of policies, development of pragmatic corporate sustainability strategies, and the delivery of sustainability initiatives. Our clients include governments, investors, NGOs, airlines, airports, and others on the journey to more sustainability operations.
The role:
As a Sustainable Aviation Analytics Associate, you’ll be a key part of our team delivering evidence-led projects to reduce the environmental impact of aviation. You will help us develop and apply analytical models and tools to support aviation decarbonisation decision-making, including work on sustainable aviation fuels, project economics, policy design, market analysis and emissions assessment. The role sits within our dedicated Sustainable Aviation team, part of the Aviation, Travel and Tourism consulting division, with opportunities to contribute to wider aviation projects.
This role can be based in either Spain or the UK.
How you will make an impact:
· Dev elop, improve and apply analytical models and tools to answer complex questions across sustainable aviation projects.
· Analyse, manage and visualise varied datasets, helping to maintain robust, efficient and well-documented analytical workflows.
· Use coding, automation and emerging AI tools where appropriate to improve the quality and efficiency of our analysis.
· Translate analytical outputs into clear findings and practical recommendations for clients and colleagues.
· Contribute to project delivery and business growth, including research, report writing, proposals and the development of new methods and service.
· Provide ICF’s clients with robust solutions to novel challenges. To do this, you will keep up to date with new market developments, policies, methodologies and practices and developing new ways of working.
· Support business growth including activities such as building industry relationships, writing proposals, contributing to insightful articles, and representing ICF at conferences.
The knowledge, skills and experience we’re looking for:
· At least 2 years of relevant professional, academic or research experience. Relevant postgraduate research, including experience gained through a PhD, will be considered.
· Proven quantitative and problem-solving ability, including experience processing, analysing and visualising data.
· Experience using Python or another analytical programming language, or a strong interest and demonstrated ability to learn these tools.
· Strong research skills, with the ability to efficiently identify and evaluate relevant data and evidence from academic literature and other credible sources.
· Knowledge of aviation, sustainability, energy, transport, environmental policy or low-carbon fuels would be advantageous, but is not essential.
· Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant quantitative, scientific, engineering, economics, data or policy-related field, or equivalent professional experience.
· Excellent communication skills including formal report writing, presentation and client management, primarily in English.

· Strong analytical judgement, with attention to data quality, assumptions and limitations

· Ability to work effectively as part of a team

Principales funciones
· Participar en la ejecución de proyectos de consultoría en cambio climático y sostenibilidad corporativa, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos, plazos y presupuestos establecidos.
· Recopilar, procesar y analizar información ambiental, social y climática para el desarrollo de estudios, diagnósticos y evaluaciones técnicas.

· Realizar seguimiento a las actividades y entregables asignados, identificando posibles desviaciones y proponiendo acciones de mejora.

Con una base sólida en industrias clave, somos pioneros en el avance de la agenda ESG (Ambiental, Social y de Gobernanza) en América Latina y el Caribe. Nuestro trabajo incluye contribuir a iniciativas de financiamiento sostenible, desarrollar estudios temáticos y apoyar la implementación de estándares internacionales para las partes interesadas.

Como la mayor consultora global dedicada exclusivamente a la sostenibilidad, nos asociamos con las principales organizaciones del mundo, creando soluciones innovadoras a los desafíos de sostenibilidad y desbloqueando oportunidades comerciales que satisfacen las necesidades del presente, mientras preservamos oportunidades para las futuras generaciones.
También consideramos nuestra diversidad como una fortaleza que nos ayuda a crear mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes. Nuestro equipo diverso de expertos de clase mundial apoya a los clientes en todos los niveles de sus organizaciones para operacionalizar la sostenibilidad, respaldado por nuestra profunda experiencia técnica en la resolución de temas ambientales, de salud, seguridad, riesgo y asuntos sociales. Step into your environmental career and make a real-world impact from day one.
At ERM , as an Senior Consultant, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Generalist, based in Overland Park, Kansas , you’ll be part of a global sustainability consulting firm that helps organizations solve some of their most pressing environmental and operational challenges. This is more than a technical role—it’s an opportunity to work alongside experienced Project Managers and Partners, contributing to projects that shape how businesses operate responsibly across industries. From compliance and sustainability to site investigation and remediation, your work will directly support safer, more sustainable outcomes for clients and communities.
Why This Role Matters?
This role sits at the intersection of environmental science, regulatory compliance, and business strategy. You’ll help organizations navigate complex EHS requirements while advancing sustainable practices. Your contributions will influence project outcomes, support regulatory compliance, and drive environmental stewardship across diverse client portfolios.
At ERM, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build expertise, collaborate with industry leaders, and develop a career path tailored to your strengths and interests.
What Your Impact Is:
· Contribute to meaningful environmental and EHS projects for large industrial and global clients
· Support compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations
· Help identify and implement solutions that reduce environmental risk and improve sustainability performance
· Play a key role in fieldwork, data collection, and technical reporting that informs critical business decisions
· Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and access a network of national EHS experts for ongoing learning and development
What You'll Bring:
Required:
· BS in engineering, environmental science or environmental science-related field (e.g., geology), occupational health and safety, or related discipline. Minimum 3.25 GPA. or equivalent experience
· 2 to 5 years of relevant environmental experience or professional internships
· Strong commitment to safety, with the ability to work safely outdoors in variable weather conditions and challenging terrain
· Detail-oriented with excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting/problem-solving skills
· Effective written and verbal communication, organizational, and analytical skills
· Experience recording and writing detailed technical data and reports, and building tables and spreadsheets (including tabulation and manipulation of data)
· Demonstrated attributes to become a strong consultant: team-oriented, eager to learn and grow, self-starter, versatile, and service-oriented
· Highly organized with a keen eye for detail, while maintaining a big-picture perspective
· High-level proficiency in Microsoft Office programs
· Driver's License Required: This position requires a valid driver's license and/or the ability to operate a company vehicle due to the nature of job duties, which include frequent travel to various client locations across a large geographical area
· Ability to maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently
· Ability to pass pre-hire background check and drug test
· This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Preferred:
· Master’s degree in a relevant field
· Experience preparing detailed technical reports and managing environmental data sets
Key Responsibilities:
· Provide technical assistance on EHS compliance, sustainability, site investigation and remediation, and due diligence transaction projects
· Prepare plans, permits, and reports for hazardous waste, air quality, hazardous material management, oil spill prevention, and NPDES stormwater and wastewater programs
· Perform environmental compliance assessments and implement corrective actions to ensure regulatory compliance
· Provide general EHS compliance support to clients, including on-site assistance as needed
· Conduct Phase I Environmental Site Assessments to support property transactions
· Perform fieldwork including sampling, ecological field studies, drilling, well installation, remedial pilot tests, construction oversight, and system operation and maintenance
· Compile and evaluate environmental data and assist in technical report preparation
· Manage multiple projects within scope, budget, and schedule while maintaining high-quality deliverables
Who We Are:
As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.
At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.

Regulatory Chemical Safety Consultant
ERM is looking for a Regulatory Chemical Safety Consultant to join our Product Stewardship team in France. In this role, you’ll support clients across a range of sectors by helping them navigate EU and global chemical regulations, while working as part of ERM’s international Product Stewardship network.
What you’ll do
· Support EU REACH regulatory programmes, including IUCLID dossier preparation, data‑sharing activities, and Only Representative services
· Perform and review CLP classification and labelling
· Prepare and maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for EU and global markets
· Work with SDS authoring tools (e.g. Lisam ExESS)
· Prepare Poison Centre Notifications (PCN) and advise on Annex VIII requirements
· Support clients with product compliance across the lifecycle, including restricted substances, sector‑specific legislation, and country‑specific requirements (e.g. France)
· Collaborate with international project teams and support regulatory project delivery
What you bring
· 3–5 years’ experience in chemical regulatory affairs, product stewardship, consultancy or industry
· Strong working knowledge of REACH, CLP/GHS, SDS and IUCLID
· Experience with classification & labelling and hazard communication
· Fluency in French and English
· A collaborative mindset and motivation to grow in a consulting environment
Why ERM
At ERM, you’ll work on impact‑driven sustainability projects, alongside leading technical experts, in a collaborative and inclusive environment. We support your development through exposure to diverse clients, structured learning, and opportunities to grow your consulting career.

jd_text:
En ERM estamos en búsqueda de un/a Consultor/a en Sostenibilidad para integrarse a un equipo dedicado, asignado a un proyecto estratégico de certificación internacional para un operador del sector de hidrocarburos en Argentina. El rol requiere una sólida experiencia técnica en gestión socioambiental y relaciones comunitarias, articulando con diferentes áreas del negocio y aplicando estándares internacionales.
En ERM, sabemos que crear un entorno de trabajo diverso, equitativo e inclusivo es una parte esencial para hacer de nuestra empresa un excelente lugar para desarrollar una carrera.
Principales responsabilidades:
· Elaborar, revisar y actualizar reportes técnicos de sostenibilidad y desempeño socioambiental.
· Recopilar, sistematizar y analizar información e indicadores ESG de distintas áreas.
· Organizar y mantener la documentación y las evidencias requeridas para procesos de certificación y auditoría.
· Dar seguimiento a planes de acción, compromisos y requerimientos de información.
· Apoyar la identificación de brechas frente a estándares internacionales y la preparación de recomendaciones.
Requisitos:
· Título universitario en Ingeniería, Ciencias Ambientales, Ciencias Sociales o disciplinas afines.
· Experiencia en gestión ambiental y social (E&S), criterios ESG y relacionamiento con grupos de interés.
· Conocimiento de estándares internacionales, incluyendo IFC Performance Standards, Principios de Ecuador y marcos de reporte ESG y sostenibilidad.
· Disponibilidad para realizar viajes según las necesidades de los proyectos
Antecedentes:
Desde que establecimos nos establecimos en la región de América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) en la década de 1990, ERM ha crecido de manera constante, empleando ahora a más de 800 profesionales en sus oficinas de Argentina, Brasil, Colombia, Guyana, México y Perú. Durante más de 30 años, hemos construido equipos de consultoría de clase mundial, especializados en medio ambiente, sostenibilidad y consultoría social, con una sólida base de clientes en múltiples sectores económicos como petróleo y gas, manufactura y productos químicos, entre otros. A lo largo de tiempos desafiantes, ERM ha permanecido comprometida en apoyar a estos sectores, ya que nuestros clientes continúan invirtiendo en el mercado local.
Como parte de nuestra expansión regional, ERM busca mantener el liderazgo en la industria asociándose con importantes clientes que comparten nuestro compromiso con la sostenibilidad. Con una base sólida en industrias clave, somos pioneros en el avance de la agenda ESG (Ambiental, Social y de Gobernanza) en América Latina y el Caribe. Nuestro trabajo incluye contribuir a iniciativas de financiamiento sostenible, desarrollar estudios temáticos y apoyar la implementación de estándares internacionales para las partes interesadas.
Quiénes Somos:
Como la mayor consultora global dedicada exclusivamente a la sostenibilidad, nos asociamos con las principales organizaciones del mundo, creando soluciones innovadoras a los desafíos de sostenibilidad y desbloqueando oportunidades comerciales que satisfacen las necesidades del presente, mientras preservamos oportunidades para las futuras generaciones.
También consideramos nuestra diversidad como una fortaleza que nos ayuda a crear mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes. Nuestro equipo diverso de expertos de clase mundial apoya a los clientes en todos los niveles de sus organizaciones para operacionalizar la sostenibilidad, respaldado por nuestra profunda experiencia técnica en la resolución de temas ambientales, de salud, seguridad, riesgo y asuntos sociales. Llamamos a esta capacidad nuestro enfoque de "boots to boardroom" un modelo de servicio integral que permite a ERM desarrollar soluciones estratégicas y técnicas que impulsan objetivos tanto en el campo como a nivel ejecutivo.
Si deseas leer más sobre Diversidad, Equidad, Igualdad e Inclusión (DEIB) en ERM, puedes visitar nuestro sitio web o conocer nuestros avances en el Informe de Sostenibilidad 2026 .

Launch Your Career in Environmental Consulting and Help Shape Sustainable Development Across Canada
At ERM , your work will help guide some of Canada's most significant infrastructure, renewable energy, mining, transportation, and resource development projects. This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career professional to collaborate with industry-leading experts, strengthen consulting and project management skills, and contribute to projects that create lasting value for communities, businesses, and the environment.
Why This Role Matters
Environmental approvals and permitting play a critical role in advancing projects that support communities, economic development, and the transition to a more sustainable future. In this role, you will help clients navigate regulatory requirements, support environmental assessment processes, and contribute to strategic solutions for complex environmental challenges.
As part of ERM's multidisciplinary team, you will gain exposure to projects across Canada, work alongside recognized technical specialists, and build expertise within one of the world's leading sustainability consulting organizations. Your work will directly influence responsible project development while helping clients balance environmental, social, and business objectives.
What Your Impact Is
As a Consulting Senior Associate, Environmental Assessment and Permitting, you will support the planning, permitting, and environmental assessment of projects across sectors such as renewable energy, mining, transportation, and oil and gas. Your contributions will help clients make informed decisions, meet regulatory requirements, engage stakeholders effectively, and advance projects responsibly.

· Support regulatory, permitting, and environmental impact assessment activities for a variety of client projects.

· Apply critical thinking and strategic problem-solving to help deliver meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Required

· Interest in project management, including deliverable tracking, budget tracking, and client communications.
· Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
· Excellent writing, communication, organization, attention to detail, and time management skills. Please demonstrate within application, resume, and cover letter.
· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools including schedules and budget tracking tools.
· Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
· Strong commitment to safety and adherence to established health and safety protocols.
· Strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

· Support multiple projects simultaneously alongside project managers to ensure successful project delivery and quality outcomes.
· Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities.
· Prepare and review technical documentation, permit applications, environmental management plans, and supporting regulatory materials.
· Conduct data gathering, regulatory research, permitting reviews, and technical analyses.
· Coordinate project-related workstreams and collaborate with GIS, desktop publishing, and technical specialist teams.
· Support proposal preparation, market research, and business development activities.
· Develop practical recommendations and solutions that help clients achieve project objectives while meeting regulatory requirements.
· Foster strong working relationships with colleagues across ERM's global network.
· Contribute to a culture of safety, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jd_text:
Are you an experienced consultant in technical due diligence and transaction advisory? Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture? Are you looking for your next challenge?
If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Transaction Advisory team as our new Senior Consultant or Chief Consultant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.
Your new role
As a Senior Consultant or Chief Consultant, you will be a central member of a highly professional and dynamic team with exposure to clients and projects around the world. Your responsibility will primarily be to provide technical due diligence services and support to our clients, predominantly in APAC, but also EMEA and the US.
Ramboll’s Transaction Advisory team supports lenders and investors in some of the largest and most influential renewable energy projects around the world. Our methods are focused on providing succinct and efficient advice to clients, focused on the major cost and performance characteristics of a project, to help them understand risks and reach a robust valuation.
We are looking for Senior Consultant or Chief Consultant to join our highly dedicated and experienced team. We have acted as technical advisor on some of the largest and most cutting-edge renewable energy projects in the world. Joining the team would give you the opportunity to have an impact on the global increase in renewable energy and decarbonization. The team is growing worldwide, and this position will offer significant career and learning opportunities to the right candidate.
Your key responsibilities will be
· Being part of the global Transaction Advisory team and providing technical due diligence expertise to clients
· Taking responsibility for project management of onshore and offshore wind projects, advising our clients and producing succinct, clear and high-quality written and verbal advice
· Analysing, reviewing and assessing renewable energy projects, including technical reviews, key project agreements and financial model assumptions
· Cooperation with team members and technical experts based globally in the organization
· Leading or participating in conference calls with clients, financial and legal advisors
· Travelling for site visits and client meetings, primarily in APAC with the potential to travel world-wide on assignments.
· Supporting business development and sales activities as may be required.
About you
· Technically rigorous and detail focused but with a commercial understanding of renewable energy projects
· Proven years of experience working within the renewables industry in onshore and/ or offshore wind, and familiar with technical due diligence and LTA assignments
· Capable of managing clients and assignments autonomously
· Must be eligible to work in Taiwan.
· Ability to project manage an assignment, sometimes under tight time and budget constraints
· Experience of working within and managing a multi-disciplinary engineering environment
· Excellent verbal and written English with the ability to communicate clearly and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience
· Cooperation and flexibility always keeping in mind what is best for the client, team and company
· Diplomatic skills and honesty are requirements in a diverse and multi-cultural organization with high ethical standards
· Must be eligible to work in Taiwan. Desirable Criteria
· Experience in consultancy
· Degree educated in a relevant technical subject
· Global offshore wind project experience, including developing offshore wind markets (e.g. Taiwan, Japan, USA)
· Knowledge of financial modelling
· Multi-lingual capability.
Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in Asia Pacific
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in Asia Pacific has close to 500 people working across ten offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Architecture & Landscape.
Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion
Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics.
Ready to join us?
Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.
Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Consultant / Senior Consultant – Strategy & Economics
summary: Consultant / Senior Consultant – Strategy & Economics UK, with flexibility on office location across London, Manchester, Edinburgh Do you enjoy tackling complex strategic, policy, economic and commercial questions for public and private-sector clients? Are you experienced in shaping strategies and policies, appraising options, assessing economic impacts or building robust business and investment
jd_text:
Consultant / Senior Consultant – Strategy & Economics
UK, with flexibility on office location across London, Manchester, Edinburgh
Do you enjoy tackling complex strategic, policy, economic and commercial questions for public and private-sector clients? Are you experienced in shaping strategies and policies, appraising options, assessing economic impacts or building robust business and investment cases? Would you like to turn evidence into clear recommendations that inform and support strategic decisions across major infrastructure, sustainability and transition challenges?
If this sounds like you, join Ramboll Management Consulting UK and help our clients understand opportunities, make investment decisions and translate strategy into action.
Your new role
Help clients make better strategic, policy and investment decisions.
We are looking for a Consultant or Senior Consultant with a background in management consulting, economics or a related advisory discipline. You will combine structured problem-solving, rigorous analysis and clear communication to help public- and private-sector clients assess opportunities, appraise options and develop strategies and business cases.
Working across energy, infrastructure, transport and sustainability, you will collaborate with Ramboll’s technical specialists to turn evidence into practical recommendations. You will bring a particular strength in strategy and commercial advisory, economic appraisal or policy analysis, with opportunities to develop across complementary areas.
Our work spans three complementary areas:
· Strategy and commercial advisory: market assessment, commercial analysis, growth strategy, investment appraisal and strategic options.
· Economics and public policy: economic appraisal, cost-benefit analysis, economic impact assessment, policy analysis and evaluation.
· Consulting delivery: structured problem-solving, analytical workstream leadership, project management, client relationships and evidence-based recommendations. A particular strength of Ramboll's management consulting offer is the ability to combine management consulting with wider technical and subject-matter expertise. Work alongside economists, strategy consultants, engineers and sustainability specialists, combining rigorous analysis with technical insight to develop recommendations grounded in how infrastructure, markets and investment decisions work in practice.
At Consultant level, you will take ownership of analytical workstreams and contribute directly to client advice. At Senior Consultant level, you will lead projects, manage client relationships, guide colleagues and contribute to winning new work.
Your key responsibilities will be:
· Undertaking market, commercial and strategic assessments , including market studies, feasibility studies and analysis of investment and growth opportunities.
· Undertake economic appraisal and develop business and investment cases , applying quantitative and qualitative evidence and drawing on economic, commercial, financial and sustainability analysis to assess impacts, appraise strategic options and support robust policy and investment decisions.
· Leading projects and workstreams from problem definition through to recommendation, structuring analysis, coordinating colleagues and ensuring high-quality outputs.
· Engaging directly with clients and senior stakeholders , communicating insights through clear presentations, reports and compelling recommendations.
· Supporting the growth of our strategy, economics and advisory work , including contributing to proposals, developing client relationships, developing new services and identifying opportunities across our priority markets. About you
You will bring depth in one or more of strategy and commercial advisory, economic appraisal, or policy analysis and evaluation. We do not expect expertise across every service area; we value strong analytical judgement and the ability to work with colleagues who bring complementary skills.
We believe the following experience and capabilities will set you up for success:
· Relevant experience in management consulting, economic consulting, public policy or a comparable analytical advisory role in the UK or Ireland, with evidence of translating complex analysis into practical recommendations for decision-makers.
· Strong experience in business case development, market assessment, feasibility studies and/or strategy development, with the ability to undertake research and turn evidence and analysis into practical client recommendations. Experience in the application of HM Treasury Green Book appraisal and the Five Case Model would be beneficial.
· Excellent communication skills , including client engagement, presentations, report writing and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to senior audiences.
· Experience of managing consulting projects or significant workstreams , including coordinating and supporting other team members.

Help clients make better strategic, policy and investment decisions.

jd_text:
This Opportunity
WSP is currently initiating a search for a Senior Consultant to support our company’s growing Resilience Services Practice. This is a full-time position located in our Miami, Sunrise, Tampa, Jacksonville, or Tallahassee offices in the United States. The position requires you to be physically located in Florida.
This technical leadership position will lead climate adaptation projects and guide decisions on resilience investments. A significant part of the role involves connecting information between the risk analysis team and the engineering/design team and communicating with clients on risk reduction within infrastructure capital investments. A strong candidate would be well-versed in project management, including client interaction, team management, and project financials.
This position will also support business development in Florida under local and national leadership. Activities may include presentations at conferences, engagement with professional groups, and other activities. Therefore, openness to learning to be comfortable with public speaking, if not already, is essential.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter and independent worker, comfortable collaborating virtually with team members, and willing to travel within Florida. The position will be part of the national climate resilience team with team members located across the United States.
Your Impact
· You are expected to lead projects/tasks and project teams on topics including project-level risk assessment, adaptation alternatives, preliminary engineering design, and communication. Initially, most projects focus on roadway infrastructure.
· You will also work closely with our risk analysis and engineering team. Our Resilience Services Practice risk analysis team includes climate scientists, engineers, planners, economists, policy specialists, and risk modelers. Engineering teams include stormwater drainage, coastal, civil, structural, transportation, alternative-delivery (design-build), and others.
· You will contribute to a diverse team of experts working to advance the Resilience Services Practice through effective data-driven analysis and decision-making.
· Prepare data and visualizations such as tables, charts, accurate reports, and illustrations for the interpretation or presentation of data, findings, or analyses.
· Maintain quality control standards and procedures for accurate and precise measurements, statistical analysis, and reporting.
· Assist with development and scoping of medium-sized projects.
· Prepare technical reports and presentations that explain research, findings, and recommendations
· Work with cross-functional teams in executing project work.
· Comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the data integrity, documentation, procedures, training, monitoring systems, and record compliance and retention.
· Interact with regulatory agencies, subcontractors, and clients in a confident and professional manner.
· Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
· Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.
Who You Are
Required Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree or higher in Stormwater, Civil, or Environmental Engineering or a related engineering field
· 5-8 years of work experience.
· Experience working on climate change vulnerability, risk assessments, risk reduction strategies/ alternatives.
· Proven capabilities for technical project delivery and working with interdisciplinary technical teams.
· Experience working both independently and on efforts requiring collaboration, remotely.
· Experience communicating technical analysis and results to non-technical audiences.
· Attention to detail; commitment and skills to identify and detect errors; commitment to thorough quality reviews and checks; and commitment to accuracy, correctness, and excellence.
· Ability to innovate on challenging topics to produce client-tailored products.
· Highly capable self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
· Ability to work independently and provide guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
· Proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, math principles, predictive models, and tools.
· Developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, statistical analysis and arriving at the most effective, economical, and logical solution.
· Ability to assertively direct others in the field, such as subcontractors, to consistently complete tasks safely and efficiently.
· Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
· Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
· Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
· Professional Engineer (P.E.), or Engineering Intern (E.I).
· Experience working with hazard data, analyzing the impacts to assets, infrastructure, and communities caused by climate-related hazards.
· Understanding of the US Army Corps Depth-Damage functions to estimate losses.
· Familiarity with the Florida DOT alternatives analysis and preliminary design processes.
· Familiarity with outputs of modeling (like StormWise), risk assessment (FEMA’s HAZUS) software.

jd_text:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?​
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
WSP is one of the world's leading engineering and environmental professional services firms providing technical consultancy to the built and natural environment. We believe that for societies to thrive, we must all hold ourselves accountable for tomorrow. For us, that means creating innovative solutions to the challenges the future will bring to the communities and environments where we live and work across the UK.
We are locally dedicated and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors, including engineers, technicians, scientists, planners, surveyors, geo-science and environmental specialists, as well as other design, programme and construction management professionals. Our experts influence and design sustainable lasting solutions in the property & buildings, transportation & infrastructure, earth & environment, industry and power & energy sectors as well as project delivery and strategic consulting services.
ROLE
As Senior Consultant - Future Energy Networks , you will deliver and increasingly lead high-quality consulting projects and workstreams that help network operators, utilities and other energy-sector clients plan, transform and future-proof energy systems. Future Energy Networks is part of WSP's wider integrated Energy Advisory business, which brings together four core capabilities:
· Markets Advisory – helping clients understand how energy markets operate, how market arrangements evolve, and how commercial value is created.
· Policy & Regulation – supporting governments, regulators, system operators and utilities with policy development, economic regulation and regulatory reform.
· Energy Decarbonisation – helping organisations, cities, utilities and governments secure, plan and optimise energy in an increasingly electrified economy.
· Future Energy Networks – supporting network operators and utilities to plan, transform, deliver and future-proof the energy systems of the future.
Energy Advisory operates as a single integrated business, and all consultants are encouraged to contribute across multiple capabilities. This provides opportunities to broaden technical and consulting skills, work on multidisciplinary projects and develop a deeper understanding of the energy transition.
Working alongside engineers, economists, policy specialists, strategists and commercial advisors, you will deliver projects and increasingly lead defined workstreams across areas such as network planning, connections, flexibility, network transformation and innovation. You will engage directly with clients, apply sound analysis and judgement, and take ownership of clear, practical and high-quality outputs.
You will contribute to the development of Future Energy Networks and the wider Energy Advisory business through knowledge sharing, business development and the improvement of our services and ways of working. We are looking for relevant experience in one or more areas, strong consulting or delivery skills, and the curiosity and potential to develop across the wider Future Energy Networks agenda.
RESPONSIBILITIES
· Delivering consulting projects and defined workstreams, with increasing responsibility for planning, coordination and successful outcomes.
· Taking ownership of high-quality project outputs, including technical accuracy, clear communication, timely delivery and effective use of project resources.
· Applying relevant experience to challenges in network planning, connections, flexibility, network transformation, innovation and related areas of the energy transition.
· Developing proportionate analytical approaches, work plans and recommendations in response to client requirements.
· Engaging directly with client stakeholders, presenting findings clearly and building trusted working relationships.
· Working effectively in multidisciplinary teams and, where appropriate, coordinating colleagues and supporting their development.
· Delivering technical, commercial, economic, policy and strategic analysis to support client decision-making.
· Contributing to business cases, regulatory submissions, market assessments, network or energy strategies and implementation plans.
· Identifying practical improvements to tools, methods and approaches that strengthen project delivery and WSP's advisory capability.
· Contributing to proposals, bids, client development and other business development activities.
· Supporting the development of Future Energy Networks services, market offerings and team capability.
· Sharing knowledge and, where relevant, contributing to publications, events and wider industry engagement.
KEY COMPETENCIES AND EXPERIENCE
· Relevant experience gained in consulting, electricity networks, utilities or the wider energy sector.
· Experience contributing to the delivery of consulting, advisory, technical or strategic projects, with evidence of increasing responsibility for projects or workstreams.
· Knowledge or experience in one or more areas such as network planning, connections, flexibility, network transformation, innovation, resilience or energy-system planning.
· Ability to work effectively in complex or evolving environments, using sound judgement and seeking support where appropriate.
· Experience engaging directly with clients or other stakeholders and translating their needs into clear, practical outputs.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
· Ability to communicate complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, both in writing and verbally.
· Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
· Good commercial awareness, including an understanding of project delivery, client value and the role of business development.
· Experience supporting, mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or a willingness to develop these skills.
· Ability to collaborate across disciplines and contribute constructively to team and capability development.
· A willingness and ability to contribute across the wider Energy Advisory business beyond your primary area of experience.
QUALIFICATIONS
· A degree or equivalent relevant experience in an engineering, scientific, technical, economic, policy or related discipline.
· Chartered status, or progress towards professional accreditation with a relevant body, is desirable but not essential.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.
Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
With us, you can.

Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup's globally connected and multidisciplinary Lenders' Environmental and Social Advisory (LESA) team provides environmental, social and sustainability advisory services to lenders, investors, developers and project sponsors on major infrastructure, energy, transport and water projects worldwide.
The team supports clients throughout the project lifecycle, delivering environmental and social impact assessments, due diligence, monitoring, management systems and implementation support in accordance with international lender requirements, including the IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, EIB Standards, EBRD Performance Requirements and World Bank requirements.
Working across Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas, the team supports some of the world's most complex and high-profile projects while helping shape industry best practice in environmental and social risk management.
Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Environmental and Social (E&S) Risk Management professional to help lead the growth and delivery of Arup's Lenders' Environmental & Social Advisory services across a diverse portfolio of domestic and international projects.
Working alongside E&S specialists and technical experts across Arup's global network, you will provide technical and commercial leadership on lender-focused due diligence, monitoring and advisory assignments across the infrastructure, industry, energy, transport, water and built environment sectors.
This is an exciting opportunity to work on technically challenging and internationally significant projects while continuing to develop your expertise and influence best practice across the industry. You will play a key role in growing client relationships, leading business development activities, mentoring colleagues and supporting the continued expansion of our global LESA business.
Key responsibilities include:
· Leading environmental and social due diligence, monitoring and advisory assignments for lender-financed projects.
· Providing technical leadership on international E&S standards, lender requirements and industry best practice.
· Managing multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on programme and budget.
· Developing and growing client relationships while supporting business development and proposal activities.
· Mentoring and developing team members and promoting collaboration across disciplines and geographies.
· Contributing to innovation, thought leadership and strategic growth initiatives across Arup's global network.
· Undertaking occasional international travel to support projects and client engagement. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
Is this role for you?
We are looking for people who:
· Have significant experience managing environmental and social impacts and risks across major infrastructure, energy, transport, water or industrial projects in both OECD and non-OECD contexts.
· Demonstrate extensive experience leading lender-funded E&S due diligence, monitoring and advisory assignments, with strong knowledge of IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles and other international lender requirements.
· Have a proven track record of developing client relationships, winning work and contributing to business growth and commercial success.
· Are confident communicators with experience leading multidisciplinary teams and engaging effectively with stakeholders across diverse sectors, cultures and geographies.
· Hold a relevant degree and Chartered professional status (or equivalent), supported by ongoing professional development.
***Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application and for the duration of employment. Any offer made will be subject to satisfactory proof of immigration status.* **
Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact Eni Makobe at Eni.Makobe@arup.com . Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
What We Offer
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. The Opportunity
Arup’s business and technology consulting teams create high-quality, innovative digital solutions for our clients. As a Senior Business Analyst Consultant, you will work in multidisciplinary teams to define problems and opportunities, identify needs and requirements, and examine options for digital solutions that transform our clients’ operations.
Our consultants combine technology expertise with in-depth market knowledge across Sustainable Transport, Clean Energy, Water, Property, and Science, Industry and Technology Infrastructure. Client satisfaction and high-quality delivery are central to our work, reflected in our repeat business, testimonials and awards.
You will work on a variety of consulting assignments related to digital strategy development and execution. The role will involve:
· Assessing the client’s current situation or challenge
· Eliciting drivers, requirements and constraints for change
· Formulating transformation roadmaps through digital change
· Supporting implementation and roll-out to enterprises and users
· Assuring that digital solutions meet business requirements and deliver measurable outcomes
Typical assignments may involve collaboration with our core engineering and advisory services. They may include shaping digital and data strategies, defining innovative digital products and services, enabling AI and analytics capabilities, improving asset management and operational processes, supporting digital twin initiatives, and helping organisations navigate complex digital transformation challenges.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

· Has experience in an IT delivery, IT consulting or equivalent environment
· Has experience applying business analysis techniques and working within digital architecture frameworks to design and implement digital products and services
· Has experience in one or more of the following markets: Energy, Water, Rail, Roads and Streets, or Aviation
· Holds a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) or SC (Security Check) security clearance, or are able to obtain it

jd_text:
Job Description
Who You’ll Work With
The AI Strategist and Management Consultant partners with clients and internal leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled transformation opportunities. The role translates business strategy into an actionable portfolio of AI initiatives, aligns leaders around the investment case and operating model, and supports implementation through adoption and value realization.
What You’ll Do
· Lead strategy and transformation workstreams that connect AI, data, and automation opportunities to enterprise priorities, customer needs, and measurable business outcomes.
· Facilitate executive and cross-functional workshops to define strategic questions, diagnose current-state capabilities, and align on decisions, risks, and next steps.
· Develop AI opportunity portfolios, use-case assessments, roadmaps, operating-model recommendations, and investment cases that are practical and outcome-oriented.
· Quantify expected value, delivery effort, dependencies, and risk to help leaders prioritize investments and sequence initiatives.
· Translate business needs into clear requirements for product, engineering, data, security, legal, and risk partners; challenge solutions when they do not address the underlying problem.
· Advise on responsible AI, governance, model risk, data quality, privacy, and change-management considerations throughout the transformation lifecycle.
· Create executive-ready analyses, narratives, and recommendations that make complex topics clear and support timely decisions.
· Support delivery teams from pilot through scale by tracking outcomes, removing strategic blockers, and evolving the roadmap based on learning and results.
· Contribute to account growth through trusted client relationships, proposal development, thought leadership, and identification of follow-on opportunities.
· Coach junior team members and model high standards for problem solving, collaboration, and client service. What Success Looks Like
Timeframe
Indicative outcomes
First 90 days
Build trusted relationships, understand priority client or business contexts, and lead defined analyses or workstreams with strong quality and pace.
Six months
Shape clear AI strategies and business cases, facilitate productive leadership sessions, and help teams move priority initiatives into delivery.
Twelve months
Own major workstreams or smaller engagements, demonstrate measurable client impact, and contribute to repeatable offerings, account growth, and team development. ​
What You’ll Bring
· 5+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business transformation, AI strategy, product strategy, analytics consulting, or a closely related field.
· Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, synthesize analysis, and develop recommendations for senior stakeholders.
· Experience developing business cases, strategic roadmaps, operating-model recommendations, or transformation plans with measurable outcomes.
· Working knowledge of AI and data concepts, including generative AI, machine learning, data platforms, model evaluation, governance, and responsible AI considerations.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear executive presentations and facilitate decision-oriented discussions.
· Strong analytical and financial acumen; able to assess value, cost, risk, feasibility, and implementation dependencies.
· Collaborative, adaptable working style and comfort partnering with diverse business and technical teams in fast-moving environments.
· Bachelor degree or equivalent practical experience
· Experience leading AI, digital, cloud, data, automation, or enterprise transformation engagements
· Industry expertise in one or more sectors, such as financial services, healthcare, consumer, technology, public sector, manufacturing, or energy
· Experience with product operating models, agile delivery, organizational change management, or benefits realization
· Graduate degree in business, analytics, technology, public policy, or a related discipline
· Familiarity with analytics tools, SQL, Python, or AI platforms; technical depth is valued when it improves the quality of strategic judgment. About Us
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.
Compensation and Benefits
Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges:
The targeted base pay for the below roles and locations are as follows:
(Atlanta, Charlotte, Miami, Austin, Dallas, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Detroit, St. Louis, Chicago, Denver, Phoenix, Portland, Nashville)
Consultants: $86,000-107,000
Senior Consultants: $110,000-137,000
Principals: $141,000-176,000
In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus .  Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.
"We will accept applicants until November 15th, or until the position is filled."
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at:  peopleone@slalom.com . Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.
EEO and Accommodations
Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact  accomodationrequest@slalom.com  if you require accommodations during the interview process.
